title: Product Manager - Enterprise Processes
description:
**Company Description**

**Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd.** is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait.**

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

"

 **Job Description**

**Job Summary**  
We are looking for a Product Manager – Enterprise Processes to own product-led transformation across the end-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) and Record-to-Report (R2R) processes. The Product Manager will own the roadmaps for selected enterprise products and initiatives, and the data tracks for commercial planning, long-term capacity planning, and revenue planning. The Product Manager will also use AI-assisted product development to replace legacy workflow solutions with secure, scalable, and supportable enterprise-grade products.

Also, manage enterprise processes as products defining value, the needs of customers, and business owners, define the Northstar metrics, prioritize the highest-value problems, and mobilize Business and Digital teams to improve measurable business outcomes.

The Product manager will create and maintain end-to-end process visibility using process mining tools to establish leading and lagging performance measures, identify root causes and improvement opportunities, and provide senior leaders with a clear, evidence-based pulse of process health, risks, outcomes and required interventions.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

A. Enterprise Data Products and Planning

* Own the vision, roadmap, lifecycle, and value realization of data products, ensuring trusted and reusable data for management reporting, operational decisions, analytics, and AI.
* Lead data tracks of commercial planning, long-term capacity and revenue planning.
* Own Product data management platform with various functions, ensuring Product Master is first time right and enable product movement with adequate controls through the value chain without delays while playing a major role in important initiatives across functions and markets.
* Use AI to prototype and build (vibe code Enterprise grade) applications to sunset legacy applications, spreadsheets, and manual touchpoints affecting master data quality and process effectiveness

B. Product-led O2C and R2R Transformation

* Define the product vision, strategy, roadmap and success measures for assigned O2C and R2R journeys; discover and prioritize user and business problems based on value, experience, risk, controls and delivery complexity.
* Map and maintain L1-L4 end-to-end process architecture in a process mining tool across business units, geographies, roles, systems, controls and key data objects; establish trusted current-state and future-state process views.
* Use process mining, and Lean methods to identify variants, bottlenecks, rework, exceptions, manual interventions, control gaps and non-value-added activities.
* Partner with Business and Digital teams to deliver process, policy, data, automation, integration and operating-model improvements that address root causes and improve business outcomes.

C. Process Performance and Executive Pulse

* Establish a balanced measurement framework covering leading indicators, lagging outcomes, activity, controls, adoption and user experience, with clear definitions, baselines, targets, ownership and review cadence.
* Create an integrated enterprise-process pulse highlighting performance trends, root causes, risks, value leakage and priority interventions; translate complex insights into concise executive narratives and decisions.
* Track outcomes such as OTIF, Perfect Order Rate, Fill Rate, Revenue Growth, Customer Retention, Day 1 Month Closure, Working Capital, and Profitability.

 **Qualifications**

**Educational qualification:** Master’s in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field  
  
**Minimum work experience**: 5 to 8 years of experience  
  
**Skills & attributes:**  
**Technical Skills**  

* Proficiency in project management methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, or Kanban.
* Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture, databases, and integration technologies.
* Familiarity with software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, and deployment.
* Experience with enterprise software platforms such as ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), Finance, and SCM (Supply Chain Management) systems.
* Knowledge of cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and their application in enterprise environments.
* Good understanding about analytics platforms like Power BI, tableau, etc.
* Good understanding about Robotic Process Automation and Artificial Intelligence.

**Behavioural Skills**

* Ability to perform tasks independently with minimal supervision, showcasing self-reliance and autonomy.
* Teamwork and collaboration skills to work effectively in a multidisciplinary environment.
* Good time management and organizational skills.
* Team player with good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality of work.

 **Additional Information**

Benefits Offered

At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.

The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.

" Our Work Culture

Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

For more details, please visit our career website at https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/"

title: Product Lead
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**Product Lead – Skills**

1. Strong domain and business knowledge in relevant product, operations, and technology areas.

2. Experience working with agile product delivery teams across multiple squads.

3. Strong knowledge of backlog management, prioritization, release planning, and dependency management.

4. Ability to assess business value, urgency, risks, capacity constraints, and delivery trade-offs.

5. Experience using Jira, ESM, dashboards, and reporting tools for backlog and delivery visibility.

6. Strong stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Delivery, Operations, SMEs, and business teams.

7. Ability to translate product strategy and business needs into actionable priorities for squads.

8. Strong communication, influencing, and problem-solving skills.

9. Experience coaching or mentoring Product Owners, Business Analysts, or similar roles.

10. Understanding of functional requirements, non-functional requirements, technical debt, production support, and continuous improvement.

11. Ability to work effectively in a complex environment with high request volumes and competing priorities.

12. Understanding of agile principles, product operating models, and governance practices.

**Product Lead – Roles & Responsibilities**

1. Act as the domain-level product lead for a defined area, such as Core, Print, or Voting/Tabulation/Edit Load.

2. Translate Product Manager strategy, roadmap priorities, and business objectives into clear direction for Product Owners and squads.

3. Support prioritization and sequencing of work across squads, including discretionary initiatives, run/OCC work, lite requests, regulatory work, production support, and technical debt.

4. Review incoming requests for business value, urgency, timelines, dependencies, impacted squads, capacity implications, and governance needs.

5. Ensure requests are categorized and prioritized using agreed criteria, such as Critical, High, Medium, and Low.

6. Work with Product Owners to align squad backlogs with domain priorities, roadmap commitments, and available capacity.

7. Guide Product Owners on backlog quality, requirement readiness, prioritization, stakeholder communication, and dependency management.

8. Participate in key business and refinement discussions for complex, high-priority, cross-squad, or high-risk initiatives.

9. Ensure appropriate SME involvement for discovery, technical clarification, spikes, and requirement validation.

10.Coordinate with Delivery Managers, Engineering leaders, QA leads, SMEs, and Scrum Masters on delivery constraints, dependencies, and sequencing impacts.

11. Maintain visibility into domain-level capacity, delivery risks, blockers, resource constraints, and impacts to roadmap commitments.

12. Identify and escalate priority conflicts, major trade-offs, cross-squad dependencies, and delivery risks to the Product Manager when needed.

13. Support domain intake reviews, backlog reviews, prioritization discussions, and governance preparation.

14. Provide regular domain-level updates on priorities, progress, risks, capacity, dependencies, and milestone impacts.

15. Coach and support Product Owners; where needed, directly perform Product Owner responsibilities for specific initiatives, including gathering requirements, creating/refining stories, managing backlog items, and supporting delivery through completion.

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

title: E-Commerce Manager
company: Aref Abdul Sattar Textiles Pvt ltd
description:
**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a proactive, data-driven **E-commerce Manager** to lead and scale direct-to-consumer (D2C), B2C, and B2B e-commerce operations across owned and third-party channels. This role is accountable for digital revenue growth, performance marketing, operational efficiency, and customer lifecycle management.

The ideal candidate will bring **cross-functional expertise**—spanning digital sales strategy, logistics, catalog management, retention marketing, and profitability optimization.

**Key Responsibilities & Expectations:**

**1. E-commerce Sales & Digital Marketing (50%)**

* Design and execute revenue-driven digital growth strategies for D2C markets.
* Manage performance marketing across Meta, Google, influencer channels, and affiliate networks.
* Optimize product listings, pricing, cross-sell/upsell workflows, and digital merchandising.
* Build channel partnerships with marketplaces and strategic collaborators.
* Drive SEO and content strategy for improved visibility across platforms.
* Oversee retention campaigns via email, WhatsApp, push notifications, and remarketing tools.

**2. E-commerce Operations & Fulfillment (30%)**

* Oversee fulfillment pipeline, from order management to final delivery with seamless TAT.
* Coordinate with supply chain, logistics partners, and warehouse teams for optimal inventory turnover.
* Implement automation solutions in CRM, supply chain, and support processes.
* Manage backend integrations (ERP, OMS (Order Management System), CRM, Marketplaces).
* Improve service quality and reduce reverse logistics and SLA (Service Level Agreement) breaches.

**3. Customer Experience & Loyalty (5%)**

* Roll out loyalty programs and tiered reward initiatives.
* Establish and refine omnichannel support infrastructure—IVR (Interactive Voice Response), WhatsApp, Live Chat, and Helpdesk.
* Drive post-purchase delight and reduce drop-offs or churn.
* Train CX team on proactive engagement and upselling opportunities.

**4. Catalog & Backend Optimization (10%)**

* Implement and maintain PIM (Product Information Management) systems for enriched product content.
* Ensure timely and structured SKU onboarding with proper taxonomy and media.
* Collaborate with designers, photographers, and copywriters to elevate UX.
* Deploy tech solutions to reduce page load times and friction in UI.

**5. Financial Planning & Profitability (5%)**

* Automate P&L reporting and sales reconciliation across platforms.
* Track returns, claims, payment cycles, and vendor fees to minimize leakages.
* Lead cost optimization efforts for CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) reduction and EBITDA improvement.

**6. Analytics & Business Intelligence**

* Build and manage analytics dashboards on tools like Google Looker Studio and Power BI.
* Monitor sales KPIs, retention curves, and marketing funnel effectiveness.
* Use data-driven experimentation to improve velocity across SKUs, geographies, and segments.

Pay: Up to ₹70,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Sr Manager, PMT, CS
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Customer Service (CS) is a large and global organization, obsessed with taking care of our customers and delivering reliably fast, convenient, and helpful support when they need it. Whether customers interact with our self-serve solutions or CS Associates, we work hard to make sure they have a delightful experience with us, each and every time.  
  
We are looking for a customer-obsessed product leader to join us as a leader for the Dynamic Andon Response Team (DART) org within Customer Service. You will lead our team of program managers, product managers, quality managers and business analysts who dig deep into peer-to-peer consultation and customer escalations, trace it back to its source, and drive upstream and downstream product and programmatic improvements to DART Usage. Your teams will own the roadmap of DART strategic initiatives primarily focused on technical solutions to eliminate wasteful usage for DART and enhance CX for DART escalations.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The role requires someone who can use significant expertise and high judgment to distill diverse inputs from customers, DART specialists and stakeholders to set a vision and design the right long-term solutions. You will spend your time analyzing customer friction data to identify the biggest opportunities and building compelling cases for improvements. This means diving deep into significantly complex problems where defects create friction across multiple parts of the customer journey. You will work across multiple organizations and leadership to influence and achieve consensus on priorities.  
  
You will partner on product and technology solutions within and outside the Amazon Customer Service org to drive high impact innovation and improvements that can transform the service experience we offer to our customers.
  
Your teams will create mechanisms that make defect elimination sustainable. This includes building dashboards and tools that show customer impact, designing processes that catch problems before they reach customers, and establishing metrics that keep everyone focused on goals. You will be regularly working at both tactical and strategic levels to deliver results.
  
  
This is the right role for you if:  

* You can handle significantly complex problems and efforts, with the ability to see both visible and not-yet-visible risks.
* You excel at taking complex technical problems and explaining them clearly to drive consensus among stakeholders.
* You can work strategically to determine where resources are best applied while actively working to remove bottlenecks.
* You create scalable mechanisms and best practices while effectively influencing and force multiplying across organizations.
* You have deep customer obsession and can translate that into measurable improvements in customer experience.
* Lead multiple teams to improve customer experience by proactively identifying and eliminating sources of customer escalations and associate consult contacts.
* Own the DART Usage Rate improvement vision and create scalable mechanisms to drive organizational change.
* Establish data-driven approaches to surface customer pain points and drive upstream action across organizations.
* Influence senior leaders to prioritize and address systemic customer experience issues causing escalations through high-quality analytics and communication.
* Advocate for customers in product, design, and operational decisions across organizations.
* Deliver measurable outcomes aligned with organizational goals.
* Write and present clear narratives to drive alignment and decision-making.
* Coach and develop high-performing teams while creating leadership opportunities.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6+ years of team management experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience delivering consumer software products and services in a high growth environment

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Senior Product Associate-Reliability & Engineering enablement
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Make your mark by improving how engineering teams build, test, and release software with confidence. Join a team that turns operational pain points into durable product capabilities that increase stability, resilience, and delivery speed. Bring your product and reliability expertise to a role with strong cross-team visibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful impact.

As a **Senior Product Associate** within the **Consumer & Community Banking**, you will own the delivery and day-to-day product operations for an application and environment management capability. You will partner with product, engineering, and support teams to define roadmap outcomes, translate needs into well-formed requirements, and drive end-to-end execution. You will embed reliability practices into delivery through measurable service targets, incident learning, and automation. You will guide prioritization using operational signals, user feedback, and risk-based trade-offs.

**Job responsibilities**

* Product Ownership: Partner with the Product Manager to define and deliver roadmap items for A-CUBE and lower-environment management capabilities. Operational Runbook: Lead day-to-day product operations for A-CUBE, including runbooks, playbooks, incident triage flows, and post-incident follow-up.
* Integration & Delivery: Manage backlog of engineering work to improve stability and resiliency across production and non-production environments; coordinate integration testing and end-to-end validations.
* Requirements & Execution: Write epics, requirements, and user stories; prioritize backlog with clear acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.
* SRE & Reliability: Champion site reliability engineering practices, SLO-driven monitoring, alerting refinement, and automation to reduce manual toil.  
  CI/CD & Test Automation: Advocate and coordinate continuous integration/delivery and automated testing (unit, component, contract, end-to-end, production-level checks).
* Observability & Telemetry: Define and track metrics (SLOs, MTTR, false positive/alert rates), own observability requirements, and collaborate on telemetry collection using tools like Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk.
* Stakeholder Management: Liaise with support teams (Goalkeepers), product stakeholders, and engineering managers to align priorities, communicate release risks, and drive adoption.
* Governance & Hygiene: Enforce governance standards and hygiene practices for applications and environments (access, configuration, test-data, reset processes).

  Data-Informed Decisions: Use user research, incident data, and monitoring signals to surface high-value product enhancements and measure impact.

  **Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**
* Experience: 6+ years of product management or relevant SRE/engineering program management experience with demonstrated end-to-end delivery.
* SRE Expertise: Hands-on understanding of site reliability engineering concepts (SLO/SLI, incident lifecycle, runbooks).
* CI/CD & Testing: Proven experience with CI/CD pipelines and test automation integrated into delivery workflows.
* Observability: Practical experience with monitoring/telemetry tools (Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk or equivalent).
* Technical Fluency: Comfortable reading logs/metrics, writing acceptance criteria for engineering work, and collaborating on technical trade-offs.
* Agile Practice: Deep knowledge of Agile processes and use of Jira/Confluence (or JIRA Align) for planning and tracking.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication; experience running cross-functional demos, stakeholder briefings, and post-incident reviews.
* Self-Starter: Autonomous, prioritizes well in fast-paced environments, and executes under ambiguity.

  **Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**
* Domain Experience: Prior experience in lower-environment management, test environments orchestration, or similar operations-heavy products.
* Observability Depth: Expertise in white/black-box monitoring, SLO alerting design, and telemetry pipelines.
* Automated Testing Breadth: Experience implementing contract, component, and production-testing strategies.
* AI/ML Product Exposure: Experience shipping or operating products that embed AI agents or pipelines.
* Enterprise Context: Demonstrated success working in large, matrixed organizations and coordinating across multiple teams.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

  

The Digital team is dedicated to creating innovative, industry-leading products and experiences that help customers access, share and control their financial data so they can make smart decisions with their money. title: Senior Engineer II, Multi-technology Product Design
description:
Job Description:

**About the role**

We're looking for a senior Technical Product Manager who combines deep process automation expertise with strong technical leadership, customer focus, and business judgment.

You will work across customers, engineering teams, architects, cybersecurity specialists, and business leaders to identify the most important problems worth solving, shape product and technology investments, and drive execution across a global matrixed organization.

This role is for someone who takes ownership, challenges assumptions, influences without authority, and enjoys turning complex ideas into delivered outcomes.

**What you'll do**

* Define product strategy, roadmap priorities, and technology investment recommendations.
* Engage directly with customers to understand problems, validate opportunities, and shape future offerings.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning software, firmware, hardware, systems, cybersecurity, networking, and cloud technologies.
* Build alignment across globally distributed teams and drive issues to resolution.
* Challenge requirements, estimates, architectures, and plans to improve outcomes.
* Develop business cases and investment recommendations based on customer value, strategic alignment, technical risk, and business impact.
* Partner with engineering leaders and architects to guide platform evolution and modernization.
* Present recommendations and product strategy to customers, senior leadership, and industry audiences.

(External) English Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Significant experience in process automation, distributed control systems, industrial software, embedded systems, instrumentation, or control engineering.
* Demonstrated technical leadership experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Proven ability to influence technical and business decisions without direct authority.
* Strong understanding of software, firmware, hardware, networking, cybersecurity, and systems architecture concepts.

title: Business Lead
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document requirements for digital asset and capital markets solutions.
* Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and product requirements.
* Work with developers, architects, and product teams to design solutions aligned with business objectives.
* Analyze securities/asset lifecycle, tokenization, and digital asset product orchestration requirements.
* Apply knowledge of DLT/blockchain concepts, including smart contracts, nodes, APIs, and consensus mechanisms.
* Conduct gap/impact analysis, UAT, and support solutions through the SDLC.
* Act as a bridge between business and technology teams and support production issues and root-cause analysis.
* Understand token economics and collaborate with stakeholders to drive business adoption.

### **Required Skills:**

  

* 8–12 years of experience in Business Analysis/Product Analysis within capital markets, fintech, or financial services.
* Strong knowledge of the Broadridge ecosystem and securities asset lifecycle.
* Experience in digital assets, tokenization, blockchain/DLT, or digital securities.
* Understanding of smart contracts, nodes, APIs, and consensus mechanisms.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

description:

The Windows + Devices Fundamentals team builds and operates data platforms and backend services that help teams improve Windows performance, power efficiency, and reliability. We connect signals from labs and the installed base to trustworthy metrics, actionable diagnostics, and measurable improvements in responsiveness, battery life, memory efficiency, and device health.

We are looking for a **Product Manager II** to own a data and services product area, from understanding the problem through delivery, adoption, and improvement. You will work closely with engineering, data science, and partner PMs to make data trustworthy, services useful, and insights actionable. This role combines hands-on analysis with product ownership: asking the right questions, defining clear requirements, and following through until the work makes a measurable difference.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Own a feature area: Understand the needs of teams using our data and services. Define problem statements, requirements, success measures, and acceptance criteria; prioritize the backlog within the team's broader roadmap.
* Measurement and analysis: Define scoped metrics, queries, baselines, and cohorts. Use SQL/KQL to investigate product-health movements; work with data science and engineering to understand statistical uncertainty and separate customer regressions from data or population changes.
* Improve data quality: Partner with engineering on instrumentation, schemas, and ingestion-to-consumption pipeline requirements. Define checks for completeness, correctness, freshness, and schema changes; incorporate privacy and security needs into the feature plan.

* Deliver with partners: Coordinate milestones, dependencies, and risks for your feature area. Work with engineering on safe rollout, release criteria, monitoring, and service-health guardrails; communicate blockers and resolve issues early.
* Learn from operation: Track adoption, data quality, and service health after release. Use partner feedback and operational findings to prioritize improvements in usability, reliability, latency, and cost.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI
description:
**Our Company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will serve as a Senior Product Manager for Teradata's vector search and unstructured data capabilities, driving product vision, strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption. You will define how enterprises turn documents, images, audio, and other unstructured content into searchable, trusted context that AI applications and agents can retrieve at scale, alongside the structured data they already manage in Teradata.

On the retrieval side, you will own the product direction for vector and hybrid search: indexing and approximate nearest neighbor techniques, filtering, ranking and re-ranking, and the balance between recall, latency, freshness, and cost. You will work with engineering to make vector search a first-class, SQL-native capability that performs at enterprise scale and concurrency, and you will define how relevance and quality are measured, not only how fast queries run.

On the ingestion side, you will own how unstructured data gets into the platform: connectors to object stores and enterprise content sources, document parsing, OCR, chunking, metadata extraction, embedding generation, and incremental refresh. You will shape pipelines that are reliable, governed, and cost-efficient, with access controls, lineage, and sensitive-data handling that carry through from source to retrieved result.

Your impact will be measured by customers moving from retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) prototypes to production AI applications and agents that run on trusted enterprise data, with measurable gains in answer quality, time to value, and cost per query.

**Who You Will Work With**

You will collaborate with customers, engineering, the database engine and SQL teams, AI platform and data science teams, cloud infrastructure, UX, governance and security, product marketing, and field teams to bring next-generation retrieval capabilities into Teradata's enterprise ecosystem. You will be responsible for ensuring our products meet business objectives.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from a recognized institution. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

* 6+ years of experience in software product development companies, including 3+ years in product management working with AI/ML, search, or data platform products.

* Strong knowledge of embeddings and vector search, including index types (such as HNSW and IVF), quantization, filtered and hybrid search (keyword plus vector), and re-ranking.

* Working understanding of RAG, LLMs, and AI agents, and how retrieval quality drives answer quality. Experience defining evaluation metrics such as recall, precision, and relevance.

* Understanding of unstructured data ingestion: document parsing, OCR, chunking strategies, multimodal content, metadata extraction, and embedding pipelines, including GPU considerations.

* Experience with data pipelines and connectors on cloud object storage, including batch and incremental or streaming ingestion.

* Experience with APIs, SDKs, and integrations for enterprise and developer adoption, including open ecosystems such as Python, Jupyter, and agent frameworks.

* Familiarity with the competitive landscape, such as Pinecone, Elasticsearch and OpenSearch, pgvector, Snowflake, Databricks, and MongoDB, and the ability to benchmark against it.

* Excellent communication skills, with a strong track record of customer engagement, product KPIs, and prioritization.

* Experience with AI productivity tools, and the ability to work independently and deliver high quality outcomes in fast-paced environments.

**What You Will Bring**

* Experience building search, retrieval, or data ingestion products at scale, with a clear view of the trade-offs between recall, latency, freshness, and cost.

* Hands-on exposure to building RAG applications or agents on structured and unstructured enterprise data.

* A quality mindset: the discipline to build benchmarks and evaluation sets, and to let data decide between approaches.

* A strong understanding of responsible AI, including explainability, auditability, and protection of sensitive data in retrieval.

* Vision to anticipate how agents will use retrieval, and to position Teradata's offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.

* Passion for intuitive developer and user experiences, such as natural language search and simple, SQL-friendly interfaces.

* Ability to influence engineering and go-to-market teams without direct authority, and to mentor others.

#LI-NM1

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**JOB PURPOSE:**

Provide senior individual-contributor technical leadership for OTC formulation science, product design, development, scale-up, technology transfer, regulatory technical support, and lifecycle management across consumer healthcare products and dosage forms.

The Principal Scientist, OTC Formulation is a individual-contributor technical authority responsible for shaping formulation strategy and resolving complex technical challenges across OTC consumer healthcare development programs. The role reports to the Senior Principal Scientist, OTC Product Development / Formulation Science, and operates through technical depth, cross-functional influence, senior review, governance, and mentorship rather than direct line management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Formulation and Product Development**

* Define formulation strategy and technical development approach for complex OTC products across relevant consumer healthcare categories.

* Translate consumer, commercial, regulatory, quality, and manufacturing requirements into robust target product profiles and formulation strategies.

* Provide senior technical leadership for dosage-form design, pre-formulation, excipient selection, active compatibility, product performance, and risk-based formulation decisions.

* Resolve complex formulation challenges including palatability, dose delivery, solubility, dissolution, rheology, microbial robustness, preservative effectiveness, packaging interaction, and stability.

Embed QbD, design of experiments, critical quality attributes, critical process parameters, control strategy, and technical risk management into development programs.  



2. **Technical Leadership and Delivery**

title: Transportation Specialist, Relay Ops
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem-solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.  
Risk and Compliance Monitoring Team (RCMT) within NOC is the centralized risk management function for RoW Surface Transportation. This team leads risk assessments across ST programs and develops tailored risk mitigation initiatives, programs, and audits to meet the needs of our business customers. RCMT is dedicated to preventing bad actors from exploiting Amazon services for illicit purposes and collaborates closely with legal, finance, and HR departments to conduct thorough investigations and take necessary actions against such actors. We harness advanced technology to enhance our processes and develop projects, programs, and products that optimize Surface Transportation Operations across RoW countries — Brazil, Mexico, AMET (Egypt, KSA, South Africa, UAE), Japan, India, and Australia.  
The role operates on a rotational shift model (including nights and rotational week-offs) to provide round-the-clock coverage across time zones.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Investigation & Case Management — Serve as a primary investigator conducting daily investigations across assigned geographies. Review cases from monitoring dashboards, determine root cause (process gaps, SOP non-compliance, or deviations), and document findings with supporting evidence within established SLA timelines.
* Deep-Dive Analysis & Root Cause Determination — Perform deep-dive analysis into raised cases by validating operational justifications. Distinguish between legitimate operational exceptions, process loopholes, and potential compliance deviations to ensure accurate case classification.
* Data Extraction & Monitoring — Extract and manage data from multiple internal portals and monitoring dashboards to support daily investigation operations. Maintain familiarity with data sources, system tools, and reporting platforms used across assigned geographies to ensure comprehensive case review.
* Trend Identification & Anomaly Reporting — Identify recurring patterns, emerging risk trends, and anomalies through systematic review of investigation outputs. Report identified trends and anomalies to managers for further review, escalation, and strategic action.
* SOP Compliance & Process Gap Identification — Evaluate investigated cases against established SOPs and operational guidelines. Identify control gaps and process loopholes and recommend SOP revisions or corrective actions to strengthen compliance controls across assigned geographies.
* Documentation & Reporting — Generate and maintain accurate investigation records, periodic reports (daily, weekly, monthly), and case documentation. Ensure all findings, evidence, and outcomes are systematically documented to support audit trails and leadership reviews.
* Quality Assurance & Calibration — Participate in quality assurance reviews and calibration sessions to ensure consistency and accuracy of investigation outputs across the team. Cross-validate investigation findings and support peer reviews as directed by managers.
* Continuous Improvement — Actively seek solutions through logical reasoning and identify trends to suggest process improvements. Provide feedback on detection accuracy and dashboard logic refinement to leadership for further evaluation and action.
* Confidentiality & Compliance — Uphold strict confidentiality standards for all sensitive information handled during investigations. Adhere to all Amazon policies, ethical guidelines, and compliance protocols governing risk management activities.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics
* Experience with Excel

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with SQL
* Logistics background and experience in a similar role
* Proficient in Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps, data filtering)
* Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., QuickSight or similar BI platforms)
* Demonstrated investigative and analytical skills with attention to detail
* Experience preparing reports identifying findings and providing recommended remediation strategies

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Sr. BA II
description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

**Job Description**
===================

Invesco understands data and the products created from data are the lifeblood of our business. Data-first functions work together seamlessly to enable Invesco to achieve the true value of data and data products. Invesco leverages data as a strategic asset by making quality, trusted data and content available to the right people, at the right time, in the right format, in the most efficient way possible to enable both large transformations and day-to-day operations.

This Senior Business Analyst role sits within the Product Engagement part of our Digital, Distribution and Enterprise Engineering (D2E2) organization. They maintain good relationships with internal partners and collaborate with their peers across the Distribution business domain. They develop a strong understanding of the investments and distribution data and business processes, including both how it is produced and consumed across all Distribution channels and how to apply Invesco’s Data strategy and practices to drive Distribution’s data capabilities forward.

The focus of this position is to work closely with the business units to gain in-depth understanding of customer's business strategy, processes, services, roadmap and the context in which the business operates. title: Principal PM Manager
description:
**Overview**

The Defender for Office 365 product group owns the protection experience for email and collaboration across Microsoft 365. The product management team drives end-to-end ownership across the product lifecycle, partnering with groups and stakeholders across the organization and directly with customers and partners. As part of Microsoft XDR, the product spans real-time detection, post-delivery response and recovery, investigation and hunting, and pre-breach capabilities. The team owns one of the largest security solutions in the XDR portfolio and helps shape how communication and productivity security will work in an era of AI-powered social engineering, using AI to strengthen detection and making MDO the trusted entry point into the broader Defender suite. The group works at the intersection of protection efficacy, explainability and everyday usability, serving SOC analysts, email administrators and end users alike.

 **Responsibilities**

Are you a product leader who wants to own a product line that protects organizations every single day, and to build the team that delivers it Come work with us at the largest security company in the world, on one of its most broadly deployed security products.

Microsoft Defender for Office 365 protects email and collaboration across Microsoft 365. Attackers are shifting from recognizable malicious artifacts toward adaptive, multi-step social engineering, and generative AI is lowering the cost of personalizing those attacks at scale. Staying ahead of that shift — while keeping protection fast, explainable and operable at enterprise scale, is the challenge this role leads.

You will oversee a portfolio of complex engagements while developing high-performing teams and shaping a sustainable security product. You will own the overall health, quality and success of a product line and its features within the MDO portfolio.

##### **Responsibilities**

**Enable teams and build talent**

* Lead and develop product managers through coaching, clear expectations and accountability.
* Model Microsoft's Model, Coach, Care leadership culture — creating an environment where people grow and perform at their best.
* Partner with capacity and resource teams to align the right skills to the right work at the right time.
* Own the professional development of the people in your area, including onboarding, ongoing feedback and career growth, and provide managers with in-depth insight into their performance.

**Own the product line**

* Own the overall health, quality and success of a product line and its features in the MDO portfolio, strategy, roadmap, delivery and the outcomes customers actually experience.
* Set direction and priorities for your area, make the hard trade-offs, and hold the line on scope, sequencing and quality.
* Ensure consistent delivery excellence through Microsoft methodologies, quality standards and governance.

**Drive results with customers and partners**

* Engage directly with customer executives and steering committees to remove blockers, build trust and drive results.
* Partner closely with product and engineering leaders from other groups, and with business planning, marketing, sales, customer success, support and finance, acting as the point of contact for your area across disciplines.
* Manage existing relationsionship with 3rd parth companies and Identify opportunities to expand existing engagements and partnerships with our ecosystem and potential partners

**Shape product strategy**

* Define and own the multi-year strategy for your product line, what it wins on, and what it deliberately does not do, and keep it coherent with MDO's overall direction and the broader Defender suite.
* Translate the threat landscape, customer signals, telemetry and competitive movement into a clear point of view on where the product must go next, and refresh it as the landscape shifts.
* Turn that strategy into a sequenced, fundable roadmap: name the bets, the trade-offs behind them, and the OKRs.
* Build the business case for investment, size the opportunity, define the success metrics, and defend the plan in leadership, planning and review forums.
* Influence adjacent product strategies across XDR, identity, endpoint and data to help strengthens the platform.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 10+ years of product management experience, including 4+ years in security.
* Experience leading product managers as a manager, area lead or equivalent with a track record of growing people.
* Proven track record of owning a product line or major product area end to end, from strategy through shipping to measured business outcomes.
* Demonstrated success engaging senior customer stakeholders and executives, and turning those conversations into product direction and resolved blockers.
* Strong cross-group influence: able to align engineering, design, research, marketing, sales, support and finance around a shared plan without direct authority.
* Exceptional analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills; data-driven by default.
* Excellent communication, writing and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated use and adoption of AI in real-life product practices, applying AI agents and tools to research, analysis, specification, prototyping and decision-making, and raising that bar across the team.
* Advantage: hands-on background in email and collaboration security, threat detection, SOC workflows or XDR.
* Advantage: experience operating at scale across multiple product areas and distributed teams.
* Advantage: BA/BSc in Computer Science or a related technical field; MBA a plus.
* **Qualifications: Other Requirements** –

BA/BSc in Computer Science or a related technical field; MBA a plus

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Software Development Engineer II, FinTech General Ledger
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's Finance Technology (FinTech) organization is building the next generation of distributed, globally scalable financial systems — and we need your help. As a Software Development Engineer II on the General Ledger team, you will design and develop services that process hundreds of millions of transactions each month, powering accurate financial reporting across Amazon worldwide.  
  
You will work on greenfield services from the ground up, tackling complex problems in cloud computing, distributed data processing, and high-throughput transaction handling. Collaborating closely with product managers, data engineers, accountants, and principal engineers, you will have direct influence on architecture decisions and the opportunity to grow your technical leadership skills in a high-visibility, mission-critical space.

About the team  
At the heart of FinTech's mission is the General Ledger team, which builds and operates the technologies to account for and post millions of financial transactions daily to support accurate internal and external financial reporting. This team processes on average 371MM+ transactions per month, servicing the accounting needs of Finance, Accounting, and Tax teams worldwide. The work of the General ledger team is absolutely essential to meeting Amazon's critical close timelines and maintaining the integrity of the company's financial data.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

title: Campaign Executive

title: Market Insights Manager
description:
**Description**

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

This position is a global, nonsupervisory position in the Strategic Insights (SI) department within the Legal, Strategy and People division at the U.S. Pharmacopeia (USP). As part of the SI department, the Insights team performs a centralized market research function for USP – supporting all levels of the organization including the Executive Team.

The role functionally and administratively reports to India-based Sr. Insights Manager – Primary Research. The role is responsible for supporting organizational understanding of the USP’s customers and business environment and advocating for needed resources. This role manages complex, high level research projects to help decision-makers better understand stakeholders, customers, markets and trends through primary research techniques and consulting outreach. The position’s scope encompasses in-depth organizational knowledge of USP’s Public Health Programs, including official standards publications, reference standards, communications, pharmacopeial education, verification, advocacy, and other products and services to facilitate sound decision making.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

The Market Insights Manager Primary Research has the following responsibilities:

title: Associate Product Manager/Product Manager (Reference Standards)
description:
**Description**

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

As part of the USP Programs, Regions, Operations, and Strategy (PROpS) Division, the Reference Standards Product Manager leads the development and management of the Small Molecules, Complex Generics, and General Chapters portfolio of reference standards. The Product Management function is responsible for overseeing the full product lifecycle (development to discontinuation), understanding key industry trends, applying data-driven and analytic decision making and making customer-focused recommendations that drive product portfolio growth. This role is an individual contributor who will be responsible for implementation of projects and processes that enable decisions about new and existing products. Core activities will also include the development of prioritization, forecasting, and financial models that enhance product mix, optimization and overall performance. This is a highly collaborative role that will be expected to work globally across the organization including Science, Operations, Sales, Regions, Pricing, Trade Compliance, and Marketing. As a product manager, this role will drive product strategy, lead cross-functional teams in planning product roadmaps, discount and promotion strategies and ensure the successful launch and growth of innovative, high-quality standards and solutions to drive USP’s mission and vision of improving global health.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

The Reference Standards Product Manager has the following responsibilities:

* Item forecasting, pricing, and margin analysis
* Develop and present business case and supporting rationale for new and existing items
* Stays abreast of industry and market trends and key competitive intelligence to drive product strategies.
* Lead pipeline prioritization efforts, aligning pipeline to segment value and organizational strategies/prioritization
* Work with Industry Programs, Science and Operations, and others to facilitate new product launches
* Support Industry Programs, Regional and Sales staff in new product training and related customer solutions
* Support continuous improvement of forecasting and product performance against key success metrics
* Manage product mix and optimization for selection and discontinuation of products that enhance profitability
* Identify new product opportunities based on customer needs, feedback, and strategic insights
* Work collaboratively with Marketing, Sales, and Regions to launch and monitor feedback and uptake of items
* Maintain and update product roadmaps to meet targeted product pipeline and growth goals.

**Who is USP Looking For?**

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in business, Marketing or Science fields with a MBA Degree.
* Minimum three (3) to seven (7) years of professional experience in Pharmaceutical industry or related field
* At least one (1) to two (2) years managing large product portfolios across B2B and/or B2C companies and managing high performance cross-functional teams.
* Experience with financial analysis, forecasting, data and analytical tools
* Strong quantitative and critical thinking skills with ability to handle complexity and drive data-driven solutions.
* Ability to develop and present dashboards, templates and business cases supported by strong rationale, customer insights and business growth goals.
* Self-starter and highly self-motivated, assumes personal accountability for results and performance.
* Working knowledge of syndicated data and analysis, such as IQVIA, Cortellis, Dailymed, etc
* Knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint
* Strong written and verbal communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

None, this is an individual contributor role.

**Benefits**

USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.

Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

title: AI Native Engineer
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting\-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**  

Role Summary



As a Software Engineer (IC2\) at Keyloop, you will be a productive and increasingly independent member of an engineering team building the connected auto retail ecosystem. You will deliver medium\-sized features with growing autonomy, write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code, and actively contribute to team culture and knowledge sharing. We are tech stack agnostic: we believe a strong engineer with solid fundamentals and AI\-assisted tooling can thrive on any technology. This role is ideal for engineers who have moved beyond foundational learning and are ready to take ownership of meaningful deliverables within a collaborative, agile environment.



### **Competency Expectations**



Aligned with the Keyloop Engineering Career Framework, this role is assessed across five core competency domains:



**Competency Domain**

  

**What We Expect**

  


**Technical Mastery \& Innovation**

  


Demonstrates proficiency in the team's tech stack. Writes clean, maintainable, well\-tested code with minimal guidance. Follows established patterns and contributes to code quality.

  


**Execution \& Delivery**

  


Independently owns the delivery of medium\-sized features. Accurately estimates tasks and provides reliable status updates. Manages own workload effectively within sprints.

  


**Leadership \& Influence**

  


Is a positive influence on team culture. Onboards new team members. Begins to mentor interns or IC1 engineers, helping them ramp up and grow.

  


**Communication \& Collaboration**

  


Clearly articulates technical concepts to peers. Writes clear and concise documentation. Participates actively in team discussions, code reviews, and design sessions.

  


**Product \& Business Impact**

  


Understands the "why" behind their work, including the customer problem and business outcome. Connects technical decisions to user value and product goals.



  

### **Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, test, and maintain software features across the Keyloop platform with increasing independence
* Write clean, well\-structured, and thoroughly tested code that meets team coding standards and best practices
* Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and incorporating feedback from peers
* Collaborate with Product, Design, and QA to translate requirements into technical solutions
* Contribute to sprint planning, estimation, and retrospectives within an Agile/Scrum framework
* Troubleshoot and resolve defects, contributing to the operational health of the team's systems
* Create and maintain technical documentation for features and components you own
* Onboard new team members and begin mentoring more junior engineers (IC1s, interns)
* Proactively identify and suggest improvements to code quality, tooling, and development processes
* Leverage AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, learning, and adapting to new technologies and codebases
### **Technical Skills \& Qualifications**


**Required:**


* Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and object\-oriented/functional programming principles
* Proficiency in at least one programming language, with the ability and willingness to learn new languages and frameworks as needed
* Experience writing unit tests, integration tests, and practicing test\-driven or test\-informed development
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines
* Understanding of core software architecture concepts: APIs, services, databases, and modern application design
* Comfortable working in Agile/Scrum development environments
* Proficiency in leveraging AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) to accelerate coding, debugging, and learning new technologies
* A tech stack agnostic mindset: we value engineers who can adapt to any technology with strong fundamentals and AI\-assisted tooling


**Qualifications:**


* 4\-6 years of professional software development experience


**Nice to Have:**


* Experience working across multiple programming languages or tech stacks
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containerization, or modern infrastructure concepts
* Experience with AI\-driven development workflows, including prompt engineering for code generation and automated testing
* Experience in the automotive, DMS, or SaaS product domain
* Demonstrated ability to quickly ramp up on unfamiliar codebases or technologies using AI\-assisted tools


**Soft Skills \& Behaviours**


* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills in English
* A collaborative mindset with a positive attitude toward team culture and knowledge sharing
* Willingness to give and receive constructive feedback openly
* Curiosity and a strong desire to learn and grow technically
* Ability to manage own workload, estimate tasks accurately, and deliver reliably
* An understanding of the user/customer perspective when making technical decisions


**What Success Looks Like**


* Within the first 3 months, you are shipping features independently and contributing clean, well\-tested code with minimal rework
* Within 6 months, you are accurately estimating your own work, reliably delivering within sprint commitments, and onboarding new team members
* Within 12 months, you are a trusted contributor who proactively improves code quality and team processes, and you are beginning to mentor IC1 engineers
* You consistently demonstrate the ability to pick up new technologies and codebases quickly, leveraging AI\-assisted tools to accelerate your learning curve
* Your peers and manager see you as a positive influence on team culture, someone who collaborates openly and gives constructive feedback


**What Sets This Role Apart**


* Tech stack agnostic philosophy: you will not be boxed into a single language or framework. We invest in engineers who master fundamentals and adapt to any technology with AI\-assisted tooling
* AI\-first engineering culture: you will work within Keyloop's AI\-Driven Development Program, using cutting\-edge AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow, not as an afterthought
* A clear, transparent career framework with defined competency expectations and multi\-track progression pathways (Technical, Leadership)
* Real product impact: you will contribute to the Fusion Automotive Retail Platform, connecting every phase of the vehicle lifecycle for dealers and consumers worldwide
* Continuous growth support through a Personal Development Plan (PDP), regular coaching, and access to the AI Champions enablement program
* A global, collaborative engineering community grounded in the values of Bold, Authentic, and United
### **Our Guiding Principles**


**We are Bold:** We challenge the status quo, explore new technologies, and champion high standards for quality.


**We are Authentic:** We engage in open, honest, and respectful dialogue. We admit when we are wrong and are transparent about risks.


**We are United:** We adopt a platform\-first mentality, collaborate seamlessly across teams, and actively mentor others to elevate the entire team.



**Why join us?**
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game\-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

**An inclusive environment to thrive**
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

**Be rewarded for your efforts**
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply***.*

*"****At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity.****"*
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
