title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon FinAuto - Travel & Events
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Amazon Travel \& Events (AT\&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi\-year transformation of the end\-to\-end Travel \& Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI\-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context\-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.  

  

We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel \& Expense systems and support the AT\&E organization.  

  

As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI\-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real\-time T\&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and senior and peer\-level software engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations including Accounts Payable and Global Corporate Procurement. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership over decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high\-visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship. The team operates in cross\-functional two\-pizza team structures that lead T\&E technical transformations.  

  

You will contribute to a three\-tier AI architecture that answers employee policy questions in under 2 seconds with source references, and proactively surfaces policy\-compliant recommendations during booking to prevent violations before they occur. You will build modern, mobile\-first travel booking and Meetings \& Events hub experiences across 45\+ countries with real\-time validation and calendar integration. You will develop guided workflows, automated data integration pipelines, and conversational agents that significantly reduce expense report submission time and eliminate a meaningful share of expense reports entirely. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out\-of\-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML\-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction\-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single\-source T\&E analytics platform providing real\-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners.  

  

  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement scalable service architectures that power AI\-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking, and automated expense workflows for a global user base.
* Deliver working features across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations to translate business needs into reliable technical solutions.
* Coach teammates through code reviews and design discussions, raising the quality bar for the team's software and establishing shared engineering best practices.
* Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues while continuously improving system reliability and maintainability.

  

About the team  

The Amazon Travel and Events Tech team sits within Finance Automation and is on a multi\-year mission to unify how Amazon employees plan, book, pay for, and expense business travel and events worldwide. We are a collaborative, inclusive group of engineers, product managers, and scientists who value clear thinking and pragmatic design. If you want to build products at global scale that make a tangible difference in how people work, we would love to hear from you.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Product Owner
description:
At **Epiq** , your work contributes to complex, global legal outcomes. You’ll join a values‑driven community where integrity guides decisions, **relentless service** sets the bar, and we **thrive on big challenges** together. We invest in your growth with enterprise‑wide learning and mobility. We celebrate who you are, and we respect life beyond work with flexibility that’s recognized externally. Enabled by modern platforms and AI, **you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career** and see your impact at scale.


**Job Description:**

**Job Summary**
===============

As a Product Owner you are the primary link between stakeholders and delivery teams, balancing business priorities, customer expectations, operational realities, and technical feasibility. You will work closely with CTO’s org, Engineering Leadership, product management and cross\-function teams.


The role calls for a highly motivated, independent thinker who is organized, detail\-oriented, adaptable, and effective at building relationships across diverse teams and stakeholder groups.


Maximize product value by owning the definition, prioritization, and delivery of product capabilities — translating customer, business, operational, and regulatory needs into clear, actionable requirements and measurable outcomes.


**Essential Job Responsibilities**

**Product Vision, Strategy \& Roadmap**

* Define and communicate a product vision aligned with Epiq's strategic objectives and client needs.
* Create, maintain, and prioritize the product roadmap to deliver maximum business value.
* Partner with Product Management and Senior Product Owners to align delivery priorities with the broader product strategy.
* Define minimum viable products, experiments, and incremental delivery approaches that get value to business and customers early.

**Backlog Ownership \& Agile Delivery**

* Own, maintain, and continuously refine the product backlog, prioritizing on value, risk, dependencies, and technical feasibility.
* Translate business needs into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements. Lead backlog refinement and participate in sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Provide day\-to\-day requirement clarification and timely product decisions to engineering, QA, and UX, resolving impediments as they arise.

**Hands\-On AI Fluency \& Tooling**

* Use AI tools hands\-on in daily product work — requirement drafting, story refinement, discovery synthesis, research, meeting summarization, usage analysis — and maintain reusable prompt patterns for those workflows.
* Stay current on AI capabilities and emerging patterns, and translate that awareness into concrete product decisions.
* Build lightweight prototypes and clickable concepts using AI\-assisted and low\-code tools to validate ideas before committing engineering capacity.
* Identify and prioritize AI use cases on customer value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, and measurable impact, including where AI can remove manual effort from operational and client\-facing workflows.
* Define evaluation criteria for AI\-enabled features — accuracy, groundedness, latency, cost, confidence thresholds — with human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints and fallback paths for non\-deterministic output.
* Ensure AI usage meets privacy, security, client\-confidentiality, auditability, and responsible\-use requirements, and never treat unvalidated AI output as a final decision or deliverable.

**Stakeholder \& Customer Leadership**

* Serve as the voice of the customer and the liaison between business stakeholders, technical teams, operations, and clients.
* Gather and document business and customer requirements, and facilitate discovery workshops, demonstrations, and feedback sessions.
* Convert customer feedback, usage trends, and operational insight into actionable backlog changes.
* Communicate priorities, roadmap progress, delivery status, risks, and key decisions with clarity.
* Build trusted relationships and influence decisions across organizational levels, from delivery squads to senior leadership.

**Quality, Risk \& Continuous Improvement**

* Embed security, privacy, compliance, information governance, and operational readiness into the product lifecycle.
* Identify and communicate delivery risks, assumptions, dependencies, and constraints early.
* Define success metrics and track adoption, utilization, and business value to guide roadmap and investment decisions.
* Support product documentation, release communications, and enablement materials.
* Validate delivered functionality, lead feature acceptance, and support UAT, release readiness, and deployment.

**Qualifications, Requirements \& Skills**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Advanced degree, or a product management certification (CSPO, PSPO, SAFe PO/PM, CSM, or equivalent).

**Experience**

* 7\+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, Product Analyst role.
* Proven delivery in Agile or Scrum environments, owning enterprise software or SaaS backlogs.
* Demonstrated ability to elicit requirements and translate complex business needs into user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Hands\-on experience with backlog \& delivery\-management tools \- Azure DevOps (Preferred), Jira.
* Practical, day\-to\-day use of AI tools in product, analysis, or delivery work, with specific examples of how they changed your output or decisions.
* Strong stakeholder engagement across business and technology teams, with excellent written and verbal communication.
* Experience defining, launching, or scaling AI or machine\-learning\-enabled product features in production.
* Added Advantage \- Experience with document capture, classification, data extraction, or workflow automation technologies.
* Experience supporting global stakeholders and distributed development teams.
* Experience running structured pilots or proofs of concept with emerging technology vendors.

**Product Ownership**

* Backlog management and value\-driven prioritization
* Requirements elicitation, analysis, and functional documentation
* Roadmap planning and product lifecycle support
* Business process analysis and process improvement

**AI Adoption**

* Applied AI literacy: LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic and automation workflows
* AI\-assisted document classification, summarization, and intelligent data extraction
* Evaluation and quality criteria for non\-deterministic features, including human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Responsible AI: data privacy, security, confidentiality, auditability, and bias awareness
* AI\-assisted prototyping and low\-code or no\-code tooling
* Software development lifecycle knowledge; comfort with APIs, integrations, cloud applications, and enterprise architecture
* Data analysis and metrics interpretation; self\-sufficient with dashboards and queries

**Collaboration \& Personal Effectiveness**

* Stakeholder management and relationship building across varied personalities and communication styles
* Cross\-functional influence without authority
* Independent thinking, self\-motivation, ownership, and accountability
* Adaptability and comfort with changing direction in a fast\-paced environment
* Organization, attention to detail, and structured problem solving
* Customer\-first mindset and sound judgment under ambiguity
* Curiosity and continuous learning — particularly in a field moving as quickly as AI

**Domain Knowledge (Good to Have)**

* Experience in Legal Technology, eDiscovery, Compliance, Information Governance, Digital Forensics, Data Breach Response, Court Reporting, records or content management, or Professional Services.
* Document capture solutions, records management, Enterprise content management and workflow automation

**Success Measures**

You may be assessed on the critical capabilities relevant to success in this role, including:


* Product vision development and strategic roadmap execution
* Timely delivery of prioritized product enhancements against a clear, well\-maintained backlog
* Requirements quality and solution delivery excellence
* Effective stakeholder communication, alignment, and cross\-functional influence
* High\-quality release execution and feature acceptance
* Adoption and utilization of delivered product capabilities
* Measurable business value realization and operational efficiency gains
* Demonstrated, practical application of AI tools and capabilities to improve product outcomes and team productivity
* Continuous improvement of product outcomes, processes, and user experience

**Competencies**

**Integrity –** Behaves in an honest, fair, and ethical manner; shows consistency in words and actions; does what she/he commits to doing; respects the confidentiality of information or concerns shared by others; is honest and forthright with people; carries his/her fair share of the workload; takes responsibility for own mistakes.


**Client Focus –** Takes action with the clients, both internal and external, and sees their needs as a primary focus; builds a sustaining collaborative and productive relationship with clients; seeks to understand client situations, issues, expectations, etc.; takes appropriate action to meet client needs and address concerns; implements or utilizes methods to monitor and evaluate client feedback.


**Results\-Driven** – Sets stretch goals for personal and team accomplishment and works tenaciously to achieve those goals; acts with a sense of urgency; takes the initiative on actions; identifies what needs to be done and takes action before being asked; does more than what is normally required in a situation; establishes metrics to monitor progress and measure success; maintains focus by avoiding or overcoming roadblocks.


**Entrepreneurial Orientation** – Proposes innovative business opportunities/ideas to customers and business partners; encourages and supports entrepreneurial behavior in others; demonstrates willingness to take calculated risks to achieve business goals.


**Decisiveness** – Makes well\-informed, effective, and timely decisions even when data is limited, or solutions produce unpleasant consequences; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; can make tough decisions.


Your specific salary will be determined based on several factors:


* **Location\-based market rate** for the role
* **Your abilities** in relation to the job specification
* **Performance** during screening and interview
* **Pay parity** with the wider team in the considered location

Further details about the package will be provided during the initial screening call with the Talent Acquisition Team.

  


**Epiq Leadership Compass**

**Fosters Relationships \& Collaboration**

Builds trust and alignment through open communication, shared goals, and strong partnerships to drive collective success.


* Build trust\-based partnerships
* Nurture long\-term relationships
* Remove collaboration barriers
* Celebrate cross\-team success

**Engages \& Influences**

Inspires action and alignment through clear communication, purposeful influence, and a compelling vision.


* Use storytelling to build buy\-in
* Align communication with organizational goals
* Guild alignment through strong engagement

**Maximizes Performance**

Sets and reinforces performance standards that drive results, ensure accountability, and align with Epiq’s goals.


* Use data to identify improvement opportunities
* Make informed decisions
* Align team goals with boarder strategy
* Empower teams to manage their own goals
* Translate vision into clear priorities
* Prepare for disruptions with strong change management

**Achieves Operational Success**

Drives continuous improvement and operational excellence through smart processes, data insights, and quality execution.


* Improve workflows for team efficiency
* Use clear documentation and expectations
* Resolve issues quickly using data and feedback

**It is Epiq’s policy to comply with all applicable equal employment opportunity laws by making all employment decisions without unlawful regard or consideration of any individual’s race, religion, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expressions, transgender status, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, marital status, age, national origin, genetic information, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, veteran or family status or any other basis protected by applicable national, federal, state, provincial or local law. Epiq’s policy prohibits unlawful discrimination based on any of these impermissible bases, as well as any bases or grounds protected by applicable law in each jurisdiction. In addition Epiq will take affirmative action for minorities, women, covered veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. Epiq is pleased to provide such assistance and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request. Pursuant to relevant law, where applicable, Epiq will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.**

title: Product Manager
description:

The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Define long and short term product/portfolio strategies, identify market needs, define product performance indicators, managing build, launch and operational financials, whilst overseeing all stages of the product lifecycle (Ideate, Define, Build, Launch, Manage, Sunset) to ensure product delivery by ensuring that solutions are defined with high\-value requirements, compelling business cases, clear product positioning, and a clear priority order

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Degree or higher in a in a Business, Healthcare, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or equivalent practical experience
* 10\+ years of total experience with 5\+ years in Product Management
* Experience presenting to senior stakeholders and customers and collaborating with multi\-functional teams ensuring the communication and tracking of cross\-functional team dependencies
* Experience in product strategy or business development either in a strategy organization or new business
* Experience working within an Agile software development practices and methodologies
* Experience collaboratively with cross functional teams business SMEs, engineers, data scientists and analysts
* Experience using AI to facilitate everyday product processes and incorporating AI features into a product
* Proven track record of managing and delivering large, complex, multi\-stakeholder products and managing teams of product managers and product owners
* Proven structured thinker who can manage ambiguity, define a product direction and prioritization in a complex, matrixed environment
* Proven independently motivated to identify and take the steps necessary to understand the businesses, customer needs, and technologies across a variety of customer personas and product categories

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Product Manager
description:
TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full\-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.  

  

TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.

**Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium\-size customers. So if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.**

**JOB SUMMARY**  

  

TriNet is seeking a Product Manager to own and drive the payroll product area within its HR services platform. This role sits at the intersection of payroll domain expertise and modern product craft — translating complex compliance, tax, and pay\-processing requirements into intuitive, reliable, and scalable product experiences for employers and their employees.


The ideal candidate combines deep payroll domain knowledge with strong product thinking and the ability to work across engineering, design, operations, and compliance teams to deliver outcomes end\-to\-end across the product development lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the product roadmap for the payroll domain — from discovery through delivery and adoption — aligning with business strategy and customer needs.
* Translate payroll, tax, and compliance requirements into clear, prioritized product requirements (PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria).
* Partner with engineering and design as a single\-threaded owner to scope, sequence, and ship features with quality and on time.
* Drive payroll accuracy, run\-cycle reliability, and exception/error handling as first\-class product concerns.
* Use data and product analytics (especially Pendo) to measure adoption, identify friction, and inform prioritization.
* Manage the run\-the\-business (RTB) backlog alongside roadmap initiatives, balancing defect resolution with strategic investment.
* Engage stakeholders across operations, customer success, compliance, and leadership; communicate trade\-offs in clear, decision\-ready language.
* Stay current on payroll regulations, multi\-jurisdiction tax handling, and competitive/industry trends to inform product direction.

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 7\-10 years of total experience with 4\+ years in product management, ideally for B2B SaaS or HR/fintech platforms.
* Demonstrable payroll domain depth — pay calculation, tax withholding, deductions, garnishments, off\-cycle/on\-cycle runs, and compliance.
* Experience building or managing products in HCM, HRIS, payroll, benefits, or PEO/ASO environments.
* Strong product thinking: problem framing, prioritization, and the ability to balance customer, business, and technical constraints.
* Proven ability to write crisp PRDs/user stories and partner effectively with engineering and design.
* Excellent cross\-functional communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfort with product analytics and data\-informed decision\-making.
* Bachelor's degree; equivalent practical experience considered.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with US payroll and multi\-state tax compliance, or comparable regulated payroll markets.
* Exposure to PEO (Professional Employer Organization) or ASO (Administrative Services Organization) models.
* Familiarity with payroll integrations — GL, time \& attendance, benefits, and tax\-filing partners.
* Experience with analytics tools such as Pendo, and discovery practices for B2B products.
* Prior work on platforms serving small and mid\-sized businesses (SMB) at scale.

 **Core Competencies:**

* Domain credibility — can hold their own with payroll operations and compliance experts.
* Ownership — drives outcomes end\-to\-end rather than executing tickets in isolation.
* Clarity — frames decisions, trade\-offs, and edge cases in PM\-ready, stakeholder\-friendly language.
* Customer obsession — anchors prioritization in real user problems and measurable impact.

**Work Environment**

* Work in a clean, pleasant, and comfortable office work setting. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable persons with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

title: Product Manager - Business Banking -SMB Client & Frontline Experiences (Engage & Deepen)
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Join the team providing financial solutions to over 3 million small businesses nationwide at one of the world's most innovative banks.


As a Product Manager within SMB Client \& Frontline Experiences (SMB CFX), you will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Business Banking capabilities that support banker productivity, client engagement, and relationship growth.


You will work closely with cross\-functional partners across Product, Technology, Design, Data \& Analytics, Operations, Risk, Controls, and frontline stakeholders to deliver solutions that improve the banker and client experience while achieving business objectives.


The Engage \& Deepen Area Product is responsible for capabilities that help bankers prepare for, engage with, and follow up with clients more effectively. This includes banker workflow experiences, client communications, content enablement, prospecting and research tools, meeting and engagement capabilities, and interaction visibility across the banker journey.


The Product Manager will partner across Product, Technology, Design, Data \& Analytics, Marketing, National Sales, Operations, Risk, and Controls to deliver integrated experiences that reduce workflow fragmentation, improve banker productivity, and create a more connected end\-to\-end client engagement experience. This includes both internally developed capabilities and strategic vendor platforms supporting frontline employee effectiveness.
**Job responsibilities**

* Partner with Area Product Owner and Product Managers to develop a product strategy and product vision that delivers value to our business clients and frontline teams
* Identify, implement and monitor continuous process improvements across the area product
* Ensure adherence to risk and quality controls as well as promote cross\-product engagement
* Lead team members across the quad to conduct discovery efforts and research to uncover solutions and integrate them into the product roadmap
* Lead team members across the quad to create and maintain a product backlog that supports the overall strategic roadmap and value proposition
* Lead team members across the quad to complete project tollgates such as communication, training, readiness, etc.
* Contribute to and promote the framework for tracking the product's key success metrics such as cost, feature and functionality, risk posture, and reliability
* **Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation capabilities to improve employee productivity, product delivery, and customer engagement experiences.**

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 5\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area
* Advanced knowledge of AI tools and capabilities, including generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and AI\-assisted product management practices. Demonstrated ability to leverage AI responsibly to improve analysis, documentation, prioritization, stakeholder communication, and product delivery.
* Advanced knowledge of the product development life cycle, design, and data analytics
* Proven ability to lead product life cycle activities including discovery, ideation, strategic development, requirements definition, and value management
* High judgment and resilience in fast‑paced environments; demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, manage trade‑offs, and make timely decisions
* Strong executive communication skills—written, verbal, and presentation—with the ability to convey complex topics succinctly to key stakeholders


**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience leading products in a large, highly matrixed financial services or technology organization, with exposure to Business Banking or frontline enablement domains
* Experience driving AI\-enabled product experiences, workflow automation initiatives, or enterprise AI adoption programs.
* Preferred experience supporting more than one CCB Operations Function/Line of Business

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.  

  

Our business bankers work in the Consumer Bank to provide financial solutions to small business owners across the U.S. Customers turn to us for financing and advice as they start, run and grow their businesses. We partner with clients throughout the process, investing in our communities and people for the long\-term.

title: Product Owner Platforms Configurations and Data Mgmt
description:
About Sanofi

  

At Sanofi, we're chasing the miracles of science to improve people's lives. We're an AI\-driven biopharma company, leveraging cutting\-edge technology and data to dramatically reduce the time from molecule discovery to delivering life\-changing medicines to patients. Our ambition is bold: harness artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, and modern data platforms to revolutionize how we discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver healthcare solutions globally.

  

Our Team: Process Enablement Platforms

  

The Process Enablement Platforms team within Digital Tech is at the heart of Sanofi's digital transformation. We design, build, and operate the foundational technology platforms that enable seamless business processes across our 70\+ manufacturing sites, clinical facilities, laboratories, and corporate locations in over 50 countries. Our mission is to unlock value through intelligent automation, data\-driven insights, and world\-class platform engineering.

  

We're responsible for core platforms and products that sustain Digital Technologies and part of Business Processes, covering ServiceNow, Configuration Management Database (CMDB), IT Operations Management (ITOM), Asset and Hardware Management, and the data infrastructure that powers AI\-assisted IT Service Management. We don't just maintain platform, we architect the future of how Sanofi manages its technology landscape, ensuring every asset, configuration item, and service relationship is discoverable, traceable, and optimized for automation and AI consumption.

  

Role Overview

  

As Product Owner Platforms Configurations and Data Management, you will be a technical leader and hands\-on architect responsible for evolving Sanofi's CMDB, Discovery, and configuration data ecosystem into an AI\-ready, data\-centric foundation. This is not a traditional ServiceNow administration role, this is a strategic technical leadership position that bridges platform engineering, data management, AI integration, and DevOps.

  

You will lead a team of developers, drive technical excellence, and champion the transformation from configuration management to intelligent data operations. You'll work at the intersection of ServiceNow, Snowflake, Generative AI, and modern data platforms, building integrations via APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP), harmonizing data across systems, and implementing automation that challenges the status quo.

  

This role demands a proactive problem\-solver who can code, architect, mentor, and lead, someone equally comfortable designing and implementing data models, writing scripts, configuring ServiceNow Discovery and Service Mappings, and collaborating with AI engineers to build next\-generation capabilities.

  

Main Responsibilities

 **Technical Leadership \& Development**

  

* Lead the design, development, and optimization of ServiceNow CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, and ITOM capabilities
* Architect and implement data integrations between ServiceNow, Snowflake, and enterprise data platforms using REST/GraphQL APIs, MCP (Model Context Protocol), and application\-to\-application (A2A) patterns
* Develop automation scripts and workflows using JavaScript, Python, or other scripting languages to enhance platform capabilities and data quality
* Design and maintain data structures, schemas, and harmonization logic to ensure consistency across configuration, asset, and infrastructure data
* Leverage Generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, GPT models) and AI algorithms to automate discovery, classification, relationship mapping, and anomaly detection
* Implement DevOps practices for platform development, including CI/CD pipelines, version control, and automated deployment across development, test, and production environments

 **CMDB \& Data Management Excellence**

  

* Own the strategy and execution of CMDB maturity, ensuring alignment with Common Service Data Model (CSDM) standards
* Drive automated discovery and service mapping across hybrid cloud, on\-premises, and SaaS environments
* Establish data quality frameworks, KPIs, and governance processes to maintain high\-integrity configuration and asset data
* Technically and processually lead Software Asset Management (SAM) and Hardware Asset Management (HAM) initiatives, ensuring compliance and optimization
* Define and implement data harmonization strategies to integrate CMDB data with Snowflake, data lakes, and analytics platforms

 **Product \& Roadmap Ownership**

  

* Define and prioritize the product roadmap for Platforms Configurations and Data Management in collaboration with stakeholders
* Manage the full product lifecycle: ideation, development, deployment, maintenance, and continuous improvement
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, IT Strategy, and business process owners to align platform capabilities with strategic initiatives
* Evaluate emerging technologies and methodologies (AI/ML, DataOps, AIOps) and integrate them into the platform strategy

 **Team Leadership \& Collaboration**

  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of developers and data specialists, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning
* Organize and prioritize team workload, remove blockers, and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality solutions
* Act as a technical point of contact and subject matter expert for CMDB, Discovery, ITOM, and data management
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including Infrastructure, Operations, Security, Compliance, and AI/Data Science teams
* Drive change management initiatives, challenging existing processes and championing data\-driven, automated approaches

  

About You

 **Required Qualifications**

  

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field
* Experience: Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience with CMDB, including automated Discovery, Service Mapping, and asset management in complex, global environments
* ServiceNow Expertise: Deep knowledge of ServiceNow ITOM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, and CSDM implementation
* Data \& Integration Skills: Proven experience with data platforms (e.g., Snowflake), API development (REST, GraphQL), data harmonization, and integration patterns (MCP, A2A)
* Development Proficiency: Coding skills in JavaScript, Python, or similar scripting languages; proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation
* DevOps Knowledge: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git), and automated deployment practices
* Software \& Asset Management: Hands\-on experience with SAM and HAM processes, tools, and compliance frameworks
* Industry Standards: Solid understanding of CSDM, ITIL, and IT asset management best practices
* Agile Methodology: Experience working in Agile environments with product management principles (roadmap definition, backlog prioritization, sprint planning)

 **Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Advanced Education: Postgraduate degree or certification in AI, Data Science, Technology Architecture, or related field
* AI \& Analytics: Experience with Generative AI tools, machine learning algorithms, and AI\-assisted automation
* Cloud Platforms: Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP infrastructure and cloud\-native discovery tools
* Advanced ServiceNow: ServiceNow certifications (CIS\-Discovery, CIS\-ITOM, CIS\-SAM) or equivalent expertise
* Data Engineering: Experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and modern data stack technologies

 **Leadership Competencies**

  

* Proactive \& Innovative: Self\-starter who anticipates challenges, proposes solutions, and drives continuous improvement
* Problem\-Solving \& Analytical Thinking: Ability to diagnose complex technical and data issues and architect scalable solutions
* Communication \& Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to articulate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders
* Collaboration \& Teamwork: Proven ability to work effectively in global, cross\-functional teams across time zones and cultures
* Mentorship \& Development: Passion for coaching and developing team members, fostering technical growth and accountability
* Change Leadership: Comfortable challenging the status quo, driving transformation, and managing resistance to change
* Results\-Oriented: Track record of delivering high\-impact outcomes in fast\-paced, dynamic environments

  

Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary

  

Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

at insightsoftware

title: Senior Investigation Specialist, Last Mile - Flex VoD
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Rabbit App Bug Triage (RABT) team is part of the Voice of Driver (VoD) organization within Worldwide Flex Driver Partner Insights \& Experience (WW DPIX). VoD is responsible for identifying, interpreting, and acting on signals that indicate friction in the Delivery Partner (DP) experience across the Amazon Flex journey.  

  

RABT owns the operational mechanism for identifying, validating, and triaging potential defects in the Rabbit application. The team consolidates feedback from multiple sources, including Driver Support contacts, station escalations, country teams, social media, and app reviews, and converts those signals into structured, evidence\-based technical investigations.  

  

The team’s role is not limited to defect intake. RABT determines whether a reported issue is actionable, reconstructs the affected DP journey using available operational and technical signals, assesses recurrence and potential blast radius, removes duplicate noise, and provides engineering teams with sufficiently complete evidence to accelerate root\-cause analysis and resolution. The team also identifies systemic gaps in product behavior, operational mechanisms, and diagnostic coverage, and works with partner teams to improve both defect detection and the quality of upstream signals.  

  

RABT is looking for a Senior Investigation Specialist who can independently manage complex investigations, work through incomplete or ambiguous information, and translate large volumes of DP feedback and operational data into clear technical findings.  

  

The ideal candidate will combine strong investigative judgment with analytical capability and operational rigor. The role requires regular use of SQL, dashboards, logs, case history, system signals, and internal diagnostic tools to validate hypotheses and quantify impact. The successful candidate will also work closely with Program Managers, Product Managers, Software Development Managers, Engineers, Operations teams, and other stakeholders across geographies.  

  

In addition to managing individual investigations, the role will contribute to improving RABT’s broader operating mechanisms, including SOPs, quality controls, taxonomy, automation, AI\-assisted triage, and defect\-intake processes.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

1\. Independently investigate and triage complex Rabbit app issues using DP feedback, operational data, logs, system signals, and internal diagnostic tools.  

2\. Determine issue actionability, identify failure patterns, distinguish product defects from operational or expected behavior, and assess potential blast radius.  

3\. Create clear, evidence\-backed technical tickets that enable Product and Engineering teams to investigate and resolve issues efficiently.  

4\. Analyze trends and recurring defects using SQL, Excel, dashboards, and other analytical tools to identify emerging risks and systemic problems.  

Partner with Program, Product, Engineering, Operations, and country teams to drive high\-impact issues through investigation, escalation, and closure.  

5\. Improve RABT operating mechanisms, including SOPs, quality controls, taxonomies, investigation frameworks, and knowledge repositories.  

Support automation and AI\-driven triage by defining investigation logic, validating outputs, identifying failure modes, and reducing repetitive manual work.  

  

About the team  

The Rabbit App Bug Triage (RABT) team is part of Voice of Driver (VoD) within Worldwide Flex Driver Partner Insights \& Experience (WW DPIX). RABT Team identifies, validates, and triages potential Rabbit app defects using feedback from Driver Support, stations, country teams, social media, and app reviews. The team partners closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Program teams to improve issue actionability, reduce defect\-resolution time, and strengthen the DP experience. RABT also develops scalable mechanisms across quality, automation, AI\-assisted triage, and defect detection to improve how app issues are identified and resolved globally.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* high school diploma or bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience pulling data from databases using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems
* Experience using SQL

title: Senior Staff Product Manager - Data Protection
description:
**Our Company**


At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.


**What You’ll Do**


In this role, you will serve as a product leader driving Teradata’s data protection product management strategy and execution across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata delivers resilient data protection for the world’s most sensitive enterprise data; spanning backup and recovery, replication, disaster recovery, business continuity, and cyber resilience.


Your impact will be shaping how customers meet aggressive RTO and RPO targets at Petabyte scale ensuring reliable backup, rapid recovery, and continuous data availability across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments. You will accelerate the delivery of the Enterprise data protection and resilience roadmap, balancing innovation with performance, reliability, and compliance.


Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise\-grade data protection and resilience solutions for hybrid and multi\-cloud deployments, differentiating Teradata and unlocking measurable customer value while preserving scalability, reliability, and cost\-efficiency.


**Who you will work with**


On our team, we collaborate with customers, engineering, cloud infrastructure, security operations, governance, field teams, and UX functions to bring next\-generation data protection and resilience capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of backup, recovery, and resilience initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives.


**What makes you a qualified candidate**


* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
* 12\+ years of product management experience, including 6\+ years leading data protection, backup and recovery, or disaster recovery products at enterprise scale, including Managed Service Providers
* Deep technical expertise across the data protection stack: backup software and storage platforms, deduplication and compression, snapshot management, replication topologies, immutable and air\-gapped storage, ransomware recovery, DR orchestration, and RPO/RTO optimization across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Proven success embedding backup, recovery, and resilience capabilities into enterprise data platforms at petabyte scale, with measurable improvements to customer SLA attainment and recovery confidence.
* Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi\-cloud architectures and their impact on backup strategy, data residency, sovereignty, storage tiering, and cost optimization.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate data protection product strategy to both technical and executive audiences.
* Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking against leading backup and data protection vendors and native cloud provider capabilities.

**What you will bring**


* Expertise architecting enterprise backup topologies, cyber resiliency and Agentic AI data protection strategies across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, with a focus on minimizing recovery time
* Hands\-on knowledge of leading backup and recovery platforms (e.g., Rubrik, Veeam, Cohesity, Commvault, Zerto, NetBackup) and cloud\-native backup services (AWS Backup, Azure Backup, Google Cloud Backup and DR).
* Ability to connect backup and recovery strategy to modern AI/ML and analytics workloads, including protecting training datasets, model checkpoints, feature stores, and data pipelines against corruption, accidental deletion, and ransomware.
* A strong understanding of backup retention policy design, covering lifecycle management, legal hold, eDiscovery readiness, and compliance\-driven retention schedules for regulated data classes (PII, PHI, PCI) across tiered and archival storage.
* Vision to anticipate industry trends, next\-generation backup architectures, AI\-driven anomaly detection for data corruption, and data sovereignty mandates and position Teradata’s data protection offerings as differentiated and enterprise\-ready.

title: Data Management Lead - Agentic AI for Data
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Make your mark by using Agentic AI to shape how teams build trusted and AI\-ready data at scale as they go through the Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC). Join the Firmwide Chief Data Office at JPMorganChase where your work directly improves speed, quality, and governance in data delivery. Bring your product mindset and technical fluency to help design a platform that grows your career through high\-impact, enterprise\-wide collaboration.

**Job Summary**


As an Agentic AI Lead for the DDLC at JPMorganChase, you will help build and scale an agentic artificial intelligence solution that enables Data Product Managers to execute the end\-to\-end Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC) – from ideation and modeling through publishing, governance, and consumption. You will translate business needs into a clear technical roadmap, validate engineering delivery, and improve how teams publish and consume governed data products. You will partner closely with engineering and business stakeholders to define success measures, evaluate capability releases, and drive adoption across multiple business areas.


This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, data product delivery, and software engineering execution. Your knowledge of agentic best practices will help build out the architecture for this solution including skills, tools and the harness. Your knowledge of data engineering/science best practices will help translate business needs into technical solutions. You will run structured discovery with business stakeholders to understand current workflows and friction points, then convert those insights into prioritized requirements and measurable outcomes. You will also support executive communications by synthesizing progress into concise narratives, metrics, and roadmap updates.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Define end\-to\-end requirements for the build of an agentic solution for the data persona that enables end\-to\-end data product development, in alignment with firmwide data guidelines and standards.
* Lead discovery with business teams to document current workflows, identify friction points, and translate needs into a prioritized intake backlog. Also demonstrate how the agent addresses these pain points.
* Design and run structured user\-feedback loops (interviews, shadowing sessions, usability tests, telemetry review) to continuously refine tool capabilities against real DPM workflows.
* Partner with engineering leads to convert business needs into well\-scoped technical requirements and discrete, assignable tasks for data engineers and AI engineers.
* Validate delivered capabilities by reviewing agent behaviors, generated outputs, and integrated workflows to ensure they match intent and agreed standards.
* Define and track acceptance criteria, success metrics, and evaluation frameworks (e.g., agent task\-completion rate, output quality, human\-in\-the\-loop intervention rate) for each capability release.Coordinate delivery execution through backlog refinement, sprint planning support, release readiness checks, and dependency management across teams.
* Contribute to the multi\-year roadmap for scaling the agentic tool from PoC to a firmwide platform – including capability expansion, LOB onboarding sequencing, and platform hardening.
* Develop a working point of view on the target agentic architecture: orchestration patterns, scheduling, agent\-to\-agent communication, memory/state management, tool registries, and evaluation infrastructure.
* Identify reusable components, shared services, and integration points with existing firmwide data platforms and skills repositories.
* Partner with governance, risk, controls, legal, and compliance stakeholders to ensure responsible use and appropriate controls are embedded into the solution. Collaborate and align with data engineers, data scientists, product managers, architects, and technology partners to achieve business outcomes.
* Drive coordination and communication with senior stakeholders to advance the DDLC strategy and secure ongoing sponsorship. Produce executive\-ready materials: roadmap updates, PoC readouts, adoption metrics, and business\-value narratives.




**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Demonstrated understanding of agentic artificial intelligence patterns, including single\-agent, multi\-agent, and orchestrated approaches.
* Working knowledge of generative artificial intelligence building blocks, including large language models, prompt design, retrieval augmented generation, context design, evaluation methods, and safety controls.
* Hands\-on experience using modern generative artificial intelligence development tools (for example, enterprise\-approved coding assistants or agent\-enabled integrated development environments).
* Working knowledge of data engineering concepts, including deployment pipelines, continuous integration and continuous delivery, environment promotion, testing strategies, and observability.
* Working knowledge of the data development lifecycle, including data modeling, schema and contract design, metadata management, data quality, lineage, and publishing standards.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.


We are evolving our product portfolio across all digital capabilities. As that portfolio grows, we need a Technical Product Manager who can connect business needs to technical delivery, ensuring the products we build are not only strategically aligned, but also practical, measurable, and well\-adopted.


We are looking for a Technical Product Manager who can bridge the gap between business stakeholders and engineering teams. The Technical Product Manager will translate business, operational, and technical requirements into clear product priorities, release plans, and acceptance criteria and will drive the adoption and continuous improvement of the products we deliver.

**What you will do?**


You will work closely with Engineering Managers, Solution Architects, UX/UI Designers, QA, DevOps, business stakeholders, and leadership to shape the product direction and ensure delivery stays aligned to business outcomes.


In practice, that means you will turn strategic intent into a clear product roadmap, define well\-scoped backlog items, and help the team build products that are useful, usable, and measurable.

**Define and prioritise product direction**

* Define and communicate the product vision aligned with business objectives.
* Maintain the product roadmap based on customer needs, market trends, and strategic priorities.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
* Evaluate market trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies to guide product direction.
 **Translate needs into delivery\-ready plans**

* Gather and analyse business requirements from customers and stakeholders.
* Translate business needs into clear features, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Define product goals, success metrics, and release objectives.
* Prioritise the backlog using business value, customer impact, and technical feasibility.
* Balance short\-term delivery with long\-term product strategy.
 **Own delivery and adoption**

* Own and manage the product backlog.
* Work closely with cross functional delivery teams to ensure requirements are clearly understood.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with Product owners, Delivery leads, Engineering Managers and Solution Architects to plan releases.
* Support user acceptance testing, production readiness, and post\-release adoption.
**Product analytics**

* Define and monitor key performance indicators.
* Analyse product performance using customer feedback, usage metrics, and business data.
* Make data\-driven decisions for future enhancements.
* Track feature adoption, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes.
**Collaborate across functions**

* Build strong relationships with customers, business leaders, and cross\-functional teams.
* Gather feedback through interviews, workshops, and product usage insights.
* Communicate product vision, roadmap, and release plans to stakeholders.
* Work closely with Engineering, Architecture, UX/UI, QA, DevOps, Cloud Infra, Marketing product teams, mobile app teams, program managers, business, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership.
* Ensure alignment across teams throughout the product lifecycle.
 **What you bring?**

**Experience and Preferred Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, or Product Owner.
* Experience with customer\-facing mobile applications is preferred.
* Minimum 3 years of experience managing digital or software products.
* Experience working with Agile software development teams.
* Experience engaging multiple stakeholders, facilitating requirements sessions, and turning ambiguity into clear priorities.
* Experience working in a medical device, hearing aid, or regulated healthcare product environment.
* Professional certifications such as CSPO, PSPO, SAFe Product Manager/Product Owner, or Pragmatic Institute certifications.
 **Technical skills**

* Product roadmap planning and product lifecycle management
* Release planning, product discovery, and requirements management
* Microsoft Azure fundamentals
* Working knowledge of AI\-assisted product discovery and documentation tools
 **Personal competencies**

* You are a natural connector, you build trust with technical and non\-technical stakeholders and keep them aligned.
* You are precise with definitions. You know that unclear requirements create avoidable product risk.
* You are thorough in documentation. You treat roadmaps, specifications, and acceptance criteria as deliverables.
* You advocate for the customer and the business, you think about how the product will be used and how it creates value.
* You manage ambiguity well. You can take a loosely defined problem and turn it into a structured, actionable plan.
 **Education**

* University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Administration, Product Management, or related disciplines.
**At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.**


Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.


With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

 **Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.**


WSA is an equal\-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

description:

**Description**


Associate Director (Deal management products\- Salesforce/Oracle APEX)
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**Core Responsibilities**
=========================

* Manage Product Managers and UX Designers, onshore and offshore, including line management, performance management, professional development, interviewing, and onboarding.
* Own a discipline within the department and manage a global team.
* Lead creation of the overall product vision and roadmap in partnership with leadership.
* Establish a cohesive product strategy and roadmap across proposal, pricing, and contracting technologies, while directly owning one or more complex products.
* Translate and prioritize business needs into technical and analytical requirements, product requirements, user stories, and measurable outcomes.
* Oversee prioritization of product features, modifications, attributes, and backlogs, and communicate priorities to development teams.
* Partner with data scientists and engineers on requirements, statements of work, budget estimates, scope, timelines, and supplier line\-ups.
* Identify unresolved business needs with internal and external clients and use them to guide product strategy.
* Drive product strategy, discovery, business\-case development, delivery, adoption, and value realization.
* Lead process standardization and technology adoption across businesses, functions, and geographies.
* Manage vendors, implementation partners, budgets, contracts, and product evaluations.
* Build strong relationships across Sales, Proposal Management, Pricing, Legal, Finance, Operations, Data, Technology, and external partners.
* Coach and develop Product Managers, set objectives, review roadmaps, delegate effectively, and establish consistent product\-management standards.
* Clearly communicate technical concepts to non\-technical clients and stakeholders and facilitate collaboration across teams.

**Experience Requirements**
===========================

* 6\+ years of product management experience in deal\-management technology within an enterprise sales setting, including proposal, pricing, and contracting technologies.
* Preferred industry experience: pharmaceutical services, CRO, or equivalent.
* Experience managing enterprise products through strategy, discovery, business\-case development, delivery, adoption, and value realization.
* People\-management experience including coaching Product Managers, setting objectives, reviewing roadmaps, performance management, and talent development. The base JD specifies 1\-2 years; the additional role notes call for 2\+ years.
* Experience owning a portfolio of interconnected products while directly managing one or more complex products.
* Strong understanding of the end\-to\-end deal lifecycle: opportunity qualification, proposal/RFP development, solutioning, pricing, approvals, contracting, negotiation, signature, and handoff.
* Experience integrating proposal, pricing, and contracting products with CRM, finance, legal, data, and delivery systems.
* Demonstrated success improving deal velocity, proposal quality, pricing discipline, contract cycle time, win rate, margin, or user productivity.
* Experience leading process standardization and technology adoption across multiple businesses, functions, or geographies.
* Experience managing vendors, implementation partners, budgets, contracts, and product evaluations.
* Experience in a complex or regulated professional\-services environment is preferred.

**Relevant Enterprise Platforms**
---------------------------------

* Proposal and RFP management tools such as Qvidian or QorusDocs.
* Pricing, CPQ, or deal\-desk solutions; experience with a custom/homegrown pricing solution is preferred.
* Contract lifecycle management and electronic\-signature platforms; Adobe Sign preferred.
* Salesforce or another enterprise CRM.
* Document generation, content repositories, workflow, analytics, and AI capabilities.
* Roadmap, issue, and backlog management systems such as Azure DevOps.
* Design tools such as Figma.

**Skills \& Capabilities**
==========================

* Ability to balance portfolio leadership, people management, and direct ownership of critical products.
* Strong product discovery, prioritization, backlog management, and value\-measurement capabilities.
* Strong people leadership including coaching, delegation, performance management, and development of product\-management capabilities.
* Strong understanding of deal\-management processes, approval controls, commercial risk, pricing governance, and contract compliance.
* Technical fluency in enterprise architecture, integrations, APIs, data models, document automation, workflow automation, analytics, and generative AI.
* Understanding of business intelligence strategy and/or data science and engineering workflows, database concepts and architecture, and common analytic languages such as Python, R, Scala, or Java.
* Ability to evaluate configuration, custom development, automation, and vendor\-product options.
* Strong business\-case development, financial analysis, benefits measurement, and total\-cost\-of\-ownership skills.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong change\-management skills covering communications, training, deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Sound judgment regarding confidential deal information, access controls, privacy, responsible AI, and regulatory requirements.

**Get to know Syneos Health**


Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

  

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

**Summary**


The Technology \& Data Solutions (TDS) business unit is the Syneos Health accelerator for life sciences innovation. TDS houses advanced technology acquisitions, homegrown products and applications, actively participates in new M\&A and partnership activities, delivers critical insights as part of our integrated strategy for customers, and drives enterprise\-wide adoption and change management for innovative technology and data solutions. Our work supports getting meaningful new medicines to patients faster, with greater positive impact. The Associate Director, Product Management supports business goals by partnering with engineers and developers to develop repeatable, production\-level tools for customers and their needs. For this position, the leader will combine portfolio and product ownership across deal\-management technologies with direct people leadership.

title: Lead Technology Business Systems Consultant
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Technology Business System Consultant  



  

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead complex initiatives to provide technological solutions with broad impact for cross functional businesses and technology teams
* Act as a key participant in providing strategic business solutions to companywide technology initiatives
* Evaluate highly complex business problems and provide subject matter knowledge proficiency for technology initiatives
* Define and lead detailed research on business and technology requests to develop efficient and accurate functional requirements
* Make decisions in highly complex and multifaceted situations requiring solid understanding of domain and technology applications, and which influence companywide technology solutions
* Lead project or systems documentation, and monitor and manage project schedules and deliverables
* Collaborate and consult with business and technology teams to provide comprehensive technological solutions for complex business problems
* Ensure communication and information flow between business and technology teams

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of Business Systems Data and Business Systems Designing experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

 **Required Qualifications for Europe, Middle East \& Africa only:**

* Experience in Business Systems Data and Business Systems Designing, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, education

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* **Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Strategy \& Ownership**
	+ Define, manage, and execute the nCino/Salesforce Integration product roadmap aligned with business and transformation objectives.
	+ Lead product discovery, requirements elicitation, and business process analysis to identify opportunities for platform enhancement and operational efficiency.
	+ Partner with business and technology stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into product capabilities and actionable delivery plans.
	+ Drive product decisions, prioritization, and trade\-off discussions to maximize business value.
* **Requirements \& Solution Management**
	+ Gather, analyze, and document business requirements, process flows, and solution specifications.
	+ Translate business needs into well\-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized product backlogs.
	+ Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and vendor teams to design scalable and sustainable integration solutions.
* **Integration \& Data Management**
	+ Lead analysis and delivery of integrations across nCino, Salesforce, Risk, CRM, and other enterprise platforms.
	+ Perform data profiling, analysis, and validation activities across legacy and upstream systems.
	+ Define and validate Source\-to\-Target Mapping (STM) requirements to support integration and data migration initiatives.
	+ Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance with enterprise governance standards.
* **Agile Delivery Leadership**
	+ Own backlog management, sprint planning, release planning, and product prioritization activities.
	+ Facilitate Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and stakeholder demonstrations.
	+ Manage risks, dependencies, and impediments to ensure timely delivery against roadmap commitments.
	+ Coordinate cross\-functional teams to drive successful execution of product initiatives.
* **Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**
	+ Serve as the primary point of contact for Business, Technology, Operations, Risk, and external integration partners.
	+ Build strong stakeholder relationships and ensure alignment on priorities, scope, and delivery expectations.
	+ Communicate roadmap progress, delivery status, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership and key stakeholders.
* **Testing, Release \& Adoption**
	+ Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities, including test planning, business validation, defect triage, and issue resolution.
	+ Support release planning, production deployment, and post\-implementation stabilization activities.
	+ Partner with business teams to drive user adoption and ensure successful realization of business outcomes.
* **Analytics \& Continuous Improvement**
	+ Utilize SQL and SOQL to perform data analysis, validation, and reporting.
	+ Develop insights and reporting solutions to support data\-driven decision\-making.
	+ Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls, operational effectiveness, and data quality.
	+ Leverage AI\-enabled tools responsibly to enhance analysis, documentation, reporting, and productivity.

 **Job Expectations:**

* Proven experience working on nCino and Salesforce platform implementation, integration, and transformation initiatives.
* Strong experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Senior Business Analyst within Agile delivery environments.
* Deep understanding of Commercial Lending, Risk Management, CRM, and Banking Operations.
* Experience with enterprise integrations, data migration, and Source\-to\-Target Mapping methodologies.
* Strong working knowledge of SQL and SOQL for data analysis and validation.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and influence outcomes across cross\-functional teams.

**Required AI Skills \& Competencies**

* + Ability to effectively leverage AI tools for research, analysis, documentation, reporting, and productivity enhancement.
	+ Strong critical\-thinking skills with the ability to validate AI\-generated outputs for accuracy and business relevance.
	+ Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, security, governance, and ethical use.
	+ Continuous learning mindset with the ability to adopt emerging technologies and innovative ways of working.

**Desired Qualifications**

* + nCino and/or Salesforce certifications.
	+ Agile certifications such as CSPO, SAFe PO/PM, or equivalent.
	+ Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise transformation and modernization programs.
	+ Strong background in integration platforms, API\-enabled ecosystems, and enterprise product delivery.
	+ Experience with reporting, analytics, and business intelligence initiatives.
	+ Experience supporting UAT, release management, and production deployment activities.
	+ Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, and Draw.io.
	+ Strong attention to detail with a focus on data quality and operational excellence.
	+ Ability to communicate complex business and technical concepts to diverse stakeholder groups.
* **Success Measures**

	+ Effective backlog management and stakeholder satisfaction.
