title: Software Development Engineer, Seller and AM GenAI Tools
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon's International Seller Services (ISS) org is seeking a Software Development Engineer to be part of an engineering team working on innovative products and tools across 3P. 3P sellers WW register on Amazon and sell a large selection of products around the WW. Account Managers and other partners help onboard sellers into Amazon and help them grow their business. We are developing innovative products that leverage generative and agentic AI to transform workflows for Sellers. Our aim is to help partners in every aspect of their daily activities as they help sellers improve selection, grow and expand their business worldwide.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

You will be a critical part of a team of software engineers, building Seller and AM tools and transformative solutions powered by cloud computing and generative AI. This role offers an opportunity to work at the forefront of agentic AI and distributed systems, building new products and services from the ground up and enhancing existing tools.
  

  

A day in the life  

In a typical day, you will be working with a team of engineers working on a variety of products ranging from AI Assistants for Sellers to register on Amazon, ensure their listings are compliant and adopt various programs to sell across markets. You will also be working on automating workflows for AMs, managing various tasks and automation. You will be working with Products Managers and AMs worldwide to create and execute a roadmap of compelling user experiences. A closer partnership with other engineering teams and applied science team will be very critical. You will be extremely curious about learning and incorporating the latest developments in generative AI to develop products that deliver agentic AI solutions.  

  

About the team  

The team sits in Amazon's International Service Org that creates tools, products and agentic AI solutions for Seller and Account Managers worldwide. The products will include a mix of solutions that are common across Sellers in multiple countries and solutions customized for Sellers in each country.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\# including object\-oriented design
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Experience building generative AI and agentic AI solutions in a dynamic fast paced environment.

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Sr Product Manager - Sales Products
description:
**Updated:** Yesterday  

**Location:** Madhapur, TS, India  

**Job ID:** 25111063


Not ready to apply?  

Join our Talent Network
**Description**


Sr Product Manager \- Sales Products
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**


Own product vision, strategy, multiyear roadmap, business cases, and investment priorities for


sales technology capabilities aligned with sales\-growth objectives.


 Translate seller and business needs into scalable product capabilities, technical and analytical


requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable success metrics.


 Lead products through discovery, user research, design, Agile delivery, quality assurance,


launch, adoption, measurement, iteration, and continuous improvement.


 Partner closely with Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing, Data, Technology, Privacy, Security,


Compliance, engineering teams, and external clients to identify unresolved business needs and


prioritize value.


 Own or guide enterprise CRM and adjacent sales technologies, including integrations, APIs,


data models, analytics, workflow automation, and AI\-enabled capabilities.


 Use customer research, usage data, experimentation, and sales\-performance metrics to


prioritize investments and make informed product tradeoffs.


 Work with engineers and partners to define requirements, statements of work, scope,


estimates, timelines, supplier plans, and implementation approaches.


 Evaluate whether business needs are best addressed through platform configuration,


purchased solutions, or custom\-built capabilities.


 Manage implementation partners, software vendors, platform evaluations, budgets, contracts,


and total cost of ownership considerations.


 Lead stakeholder communication and expectation management, clearly explaining technical


concepts to non\-technical audiences and influencing across organizational boundaries.


 Drive launch readiness, training, communications, adoption, feedback loops, and change


management; coach junior product managers or business analysts where applicable.

**Required Experience**


 **5\+ years of experience in sales technology product management in an enterprise sales setting;**

**the original role profile specifies 5\-7 years of software lifecycle development experience.**

** Demonstrated experience developing product strategies, multiyear roadmaps, business cases,**

**and investment priorities.**


 Deep understanding of B2B sales processes, including prospecting, account planning,


opportunity and pipeline management, forecasting, sales engagement, and win/loss analysis.


 Experience owning Salesforce Sales Cloud or a comparable enterprise CRM platform.


Senior Product Manager \| Combined Job Description


 Experience with sales technologies such as Salesforce Agentforce, Outreach, Salesloft,


LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Gong, sales enablement platforms, or similar products.


 Proven delivery of complex cross\-functional products involving CRM, data, analytics, AI,


integrations, and workflow automation.


 Experience working closely with engineers and leading software products from inception


through launch and iteration in an Agile environment.


 Experience managing products for external stakeholders and working with external partners in


a product management capacity.

**Key Skills**


 Strong product vision, strategy, roadmap development, portfolio prioritization, discovery, user


research, process design, and value\-based prioritization.


 Ability to connect product investments to pipeline growth, win rates, forecast accuracy, salescycle time, seller productivity, CRM adoption, and other measurable outcomes.


 Strong technical fluency in CRM architecture, integrations, APIs, data models, analytics,


automation, and AI\-enabled workflows.


 Strong analytical and financial skills, including business\-case development, benefits


measurement, experimentation, and total\-cost\-of\-ownership analysis.


 Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation, executive communication,


collaboration, and consensus\-building skills.


 Ability to balance competing priorities, make well\-reasoned tradeoffs, and synthesize input


from engineers, designers, clients, and internal stakeholders.


 Strong change\-management capabilities covering launch planning, training, communications,


adoption, and feedback loops.


 Sound judgment regarding data quality, responsible AI, privacy, security, and regulatory


requirements.


 Design\-minded, user\-focused, empathetic, data\-driven, and attentive to human\-centered user


experience.

**Get to know Syneos Health**


Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

  

http://www.syneoshealth.com

**Additional Information**


Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

**Summary**


The Technology \& Data Solutions (TDS) business unit is the Syneos Health accelerator for life sciences innovation. TDS brings together technology, data, products, applications, partnerships, and change management to help deliver meaningful medicines to patients faster. The Senior Product Manager will lead and evolve sales technology products that improve seller productivity and business outcomes while supporting enterprise\-scale adoption.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  



**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product Strategy, Vision \& Delivery
	+ Partner with Product Leadership to define and execute the roadmap for the Payer Agentic Platform (PAP) and its portfolio of AI\-powered payer solutions
	+ Translate strategic objectives into actionable product requirements, technical specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans
	+ Drive execution across platform capabilities, reusable services, and agent\-specific initiatives including Benefit Inquiry, Pricing Inquiry, Policy Inquiry, Prior Authorization, and future agent use cases
	+ Collaborate with engineering, architecture, data, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable platform capabilities that accelerate time\-to\-market and maximize reuse
	+ Ensure all product investments align to measurable business outcomes, operational efficiencies, and customer value
* Platform \& Technical Product Management
	+ Own the technical product lifecycle from ideation through deployment and operational readiness
	+ Partner closely with engineering teams to define functional and non\-functional requirements, APIs, integration patterns, platform services, and system dependencies
	+ Drive backlog refinement, prioritization, sprint planning, and release orchestration across multiple development teams
	+ Collaborate with architects to define scalable platform patterns supporting agent orchestration, grounding, retrieval, workflow automation, and interoperability across enterprise systems
	+ Ensure platform capabilities support configurability, extensibility, governance, security, and future expansion of the PAP ecosystem
* Agentic AI Product Delivery
	+ Support delivery of AI\-powered experiences leveraging LLMs, agent orchestration frameworks, knowledge grounding, workflow automation, and decision support capabilities
	+ Partner with Product Managers and Data teams to define evaluation criteria, quality measures, performance benchmarks, and monitoring strategies for AI\-driven solutions
	+ Help establish repeatable delivery processes that accelerate development and scaling of new payer agents
	+ Drive implementation of responsible AI practices, transparency requirements, and governance controls throughout the product lifecycle
* Cross\-Functional Leadership
	+ Lead cross\-functional collaboration across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, Operations, Compliance, and Business stakeholders
	+ Coordinate execution with internal Optum teams and strategic external partners
	+ Manage inter\-team dependencies, identify risks, remove blockers, and ensure alignment across multiple workstreams
	+ Represent technical product priorities and delivery progress in leadership reviews, steering committees, and operational governance forums
* Program Execution \& Delivery Management
	+ Develop integrated release plans, dependency maps, and milestone tracking across PAP initiatives
	+ Ensure product increments are delivered on time, meet acceptance criteria, and align with business commitments
	+ Drive issue resolution and escalation management across engineering and business teams
	+ Support Alpha, Beta, Production, and commercialization readiness activities
* Performance Measurement \& Reporting
	+ Define and monitor KPIs tied to:
		- Product adoption
		- Agent accuracy and performance
		- Delivery predictability
		- Platform scalability
		- Feature utilization
		- Operational efficiency
		- Business impact
	+ Provide executive\-ready updates on roadmap progress, risks, dependencies, and milestone achievement
* AI Tool Utilization
	+ Utilize Microsoft M365 Copilot to accelerate backlog creation, user story development, acceptance criteria generation, documentation, and test planning
	+ Leverage Teams Copilot to streamline stakeholder communications, meeting follow\-ups, action item management, and dependency tracking
* Utilize AI\-enabled product management tools such as Aha!, Rally, and other platform capabilities to improve
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field
* 11\+ years in healthcare services, healthcare technology, or software development , Product Management, or a related field
* 5\+ years of Technical Product Management, Product Management, or equivalent technology delivery experience
* 5\+ years of experience working directly with software engineering teams in Agile environments
* Experience translating business requirements into technical requirements, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Experience managing product backlogs, roadmaps, releases, and cross\-functional delivery efforts
* Experience working with cloud\-based platforms, APIs, system integrations, and enterprise applications
* Proven solid communication and stakeholder management skills with both technical and business audiences

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Healthcare payer experience including benefits, eligibility, claims, policy, utilization management, or prior authorization domains
* Experience with Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), orchestration frameworks, or conversational AI solutions
* Experience delivering platform\-based products that support multiple downstream applications and use cases
* Experience working with AI product evaluation, governance, and responsible AI practices
* Experience managing dependencies across multiple product and engineering teams
* Familiarity with Google Cloud, Azure AI, API\-driven architectures, and integration frameworks
* Proficiency using Microsoft M365 Copilot and AI\-enabled product management tools to accelerate product delivery
* Proven solid analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive decisions

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Product Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high\-quality products that resonate with clients.  

As a Product Manager in Business Banking Lending, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end\-to\-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top\-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality products that exceed customer expectations.


Job responsibilities




* Defines the product strategy and vision for Pricing and Risk Decision capabilities within Lending, translating business priorities into a clear, sequenced roadmap of features and enhancements.
* Owns the discovery process for pricing and risk decisioning needs, including stakeholder interviews and workflow analysis, and converts insights into well\-defined epics, user stories, and measurable outcomes.
* Establishes and governs the product backlog for pricing and risk decision work, balancing speed\-to\-value with operational readiness, risk posture, and long\-term platform health.
* Drives continuous improvement of the decisioning experience by identifying friction points, streamlining workflows, and enabling more automated, consistent, and transparent credit and pricing decisions.
* Ensures pricing and risk decision capabilities support regulatory, credit policy, and control requirements, and facilitates feedback loops that identify opportunities for ongoing product and process improvement.
* Builds features that strengthen decision quality and operational efficiency, including requirements for decision logic, approval workflows, exception handling, and audit trails, and partners with engineering to implement durable solutions.
* Defines and tracks success metrics for the roadmap, including decision turnaround time, approval rates, pricing accuracy, user adoption, and operational efficiency impacts.




Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills




* 10\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a closely related domain.
* Advanced knowledge of the product development life cycle, including discovery, requirements definition, delivery planning, and value realization.
* Working knowledge of lending operations, credit risk assessment, and pricing methodologies sufficient to drive prioritization and informed trade\-offs with engineering, risk, and business partners.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams through ambiguity, align stakeholders on scope and sequencing, and deliver durable capabilities with clear adoption and outcomes.




Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills




* Demonstrated prior experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization.
* Experience building and scaling capabilities for regulated financial services domains, including lending, credit, or risk, with an understanding of the operational and control expectations for decisioning systems used in underwriting, pricing, and approval processes.
* Engineering background combined with an MBA or equivalent advanced business degree.
* Proven track record of working through ambiguous problems and driving product growth through innovative solutions and strategic feature development.on
  

**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.  

  

Our business bankers work in the Consumer Bank to provide financial solutions to small business owners across the U.S. Customers turn to us for financing and advice as they start, run and grow their businesses. We partner with clients throughout the process, investing in our communities and people for the long\-term.

title: Senior Commercial Loan Servicing Specialist
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Commercial Loan Servicing Specialist

 **In this role, you will:**

* Lead a variety of servicing activities for moderately complex commercial products, including coordinating all aspects to ensure customer resolution
* Evaluate and upload data into the systems of record to ensure compliance with all bank policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 4\+ years of Commercial Loan Servicing experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* Coordinate all aspects of resolving open customer service issues; interact with internal and external customers
* Serve as primary liaison and work collaboratively with Sales, Legal, Control and Risk, Technology, and various Operations and company teams as necessary to progress customer\-focused needs
* Review and negotiate moderately complex loan servicing transactions, evaluate risks, and devise strategies to mitigate risks and identify procedural modifications
* Serve as an escalation point in the resolution of client issues
* Conduct quality reviews and monitor key performance metrics as related to efficiencies and effective processes
* Identify activities of the team to ensure conformity with established procedures
* Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues, and managers to resolve issues and achieve goals
* May lead projects, teams, or serve as a mentor for lower\-level staff; may contribute to strategic initiatives
* Independently resolve moderately complex issues and lead team to meet deliverables while leveraging solid understanding of the function, policies, procedures, and compliance requirements

**Posting End Date:**


24 Sep 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

title: Manager, Web Solutions Engineering, Tools, Automation and Infrastructure
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math, a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience in software development.
* 6 years of experience in full\-stack software development and system design.
* 2 years of experience as a tech lead or engineering manager.
* Experience with back\-end languages (e.g., Java, Python, or C\+\+).
* Experience with front\-end languages (e.g., JavaScript or TypeScript).
* Experience working with database technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 2 years of experience designing scalable microservice or cloud system architectures.
* 2 years of experience with site reliability engineering, information security, or DevOps practices.

**About the job**
-----------------


gTech Ads is responsible for all support and media and technical services for customers big and small across our entire Ad products stack. We help our customers get the most out of our Ad and Publisher products and guide them when they need help. We provide a range of services from enabling better self help and in\-product support, to providing better support through interactions, setting up accounts and implementing ad campaigns, and providing media solutions for customers business and marketing needs and providing complex technical and measurement solutions along with consultative support for our large customers. These solutions range from bespoke and customized ones for our customers to scalable support for millions of customers worldwide. Based on the evolving needs of our ads customers, we partner with Sales, Product and Engineering teams within Google to develop better solutions, tools, and services to improve our products and enhance our client experience. As a cross\-functional and global team, we ensure our customers get the best return on investment with Google and we remain a trusted partner.

  


The Tools, Automation and Infrastructure (TAI) Engineering teams function as a pivotal unit within TAI, dedicated to supporting the future for gTech Ads. The team works to deliver scalable, globally applicable solutions and platforms.


Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.  

  

To learn more about gTech, check out our video.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Set and communicate individual and team priorities that support organizational goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development, and provide feedback and coaching.
* Drive feature changes using data\-driven insights by analyzing data sets on users behaviors to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Optimize front\-end code and tools to meet user needs by working with engineers to refine code and tools, and ensuring that they are correct and appropriate for user needs.
* Identify, recommend, and prioritize new web features and applications by working with business leaders and product managers to understand user needs, and develop plans for new features and applications.
* Work with cross\-team stakeholders to understand the user experience by conducting user research, and working with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure that the user experience is optimized.

title: Product Manager
description:
### **About Techdome**


Techdome is a technology\-driven company that builds innovative solutions to help clients solve complex problems and stand out in their markets. Our team of technical experts and domain specialists works together to deliver software that makes a real difference, increasingly powered by AI.### **About the Role**


We're looking for a Product Manager with strong technical understanding, practical AI exposure, cross\-functional team experience, and knowledge of multiple industry domains to lead projects from kickoff to delivery, on time, on budget, and on target.### **Key Responsibilities**

* Define project scope, objectives, timelines, milestones, and budgets with stakeholders, making sure plans are technically feasible and aligned with business goals.
* Lead and coordinate cross\-functional teams across UI/UX design, frontend, backend, and mobile development, QA, DevOps, and business analysis, ensuring smooth handoffs and alignment at every stage.
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of software and AI/ML projects (LLM integrations, chatbots, AI agents, automation), working closely with engineers, data scientists, and ML specialists.
* Understand each client's industry quickly and translate domain and compliance requirements into clear technical deliverables.
* Manage internal resources and third\-party vendors, including allocation, contract negotiation, and performance accountability.
* Run structured change control for scope, schedule, and cost, and proactively identify and mitigate technical, delivery, and AI\-specific risks.
* Track project performance in JIRA or Azure DevOps and present regular status reports to management and clients.
* Build strong client relationships through proactive, transparent communication.
* Maintain complete and accessible project documentation, and use AI tools to make reporting and planning more efficient.

### **Requirements**

* 3\+ years as a Product Manager on technology or software projects, with a proven record of delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
* Proven experience working with cross\-functional teams (design, development, QA, DevOps), with a clear understanding of how each function works and how to keep them in sync.
* Hands\-on experience with Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall methodologies, and tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana.

title: IS Technology Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


ERP Manager, Operations Solutions \& Deli **Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)**  

  

There are no technical leads on this team. Everyone is a member of the technical team, and everyone stays hands\-on — senior people included. If you are looking for a title that gets you out of the code, this is not that job.

  

You will build across SAP ECC and S/4HANA, EWM, and TM, for around 4,000 business users. Extensions, integrations, data and interface work, performance. A lot of it has not been built yet.  

  

The work model for the role is: **Hybrid**

 **Reports To:** ERP Manager, Operations Solutions \& Delivery  

  

This role is contributing to the **ABB Installation Products Division** in Electrification Business Area  

.  

You will be mainly accountable for:

* **Building.** Hands\-on development every week — objects, extensions, integrations through OData and REST, and the work to keep them stable afterward.
* **Talking to the business directly.** No ticket queue between you and the person who has the problem. You sit with them, work out what they actually need, and build that — rather than building what a relayed specification said.
* **Using AI openly on the work,** and being accountable for the result. See below.
* **Shipping in small pieces, quickly.** Something small delivered this week beats something complete next quarter.
* **Keeping the quality bar.** Code review, technical documentation, design documents, recovery plans. Owned by the people who build, not enforced by someone else.
* **Security, privacy and governance compliance** on everything you touch.
* **Bringing other developers along** without stepping out of the code yourself.

 **How we work**

* **AI is expected, not tolerated.** The SAP world is conservative about this and we are not. Use assistants for development, debugging, test data, analysis and documentation — openly, and as much as they help.
* Two conditions. You own what you ship: *the model wrote it* is not a defence in code review, and we will ask you to explain generated code line by line. And throughput expectations reflect the fact that you have these tools.
* **Speed over completeness.** We would rather put something small in front of a user this week and learn from it than hand over something finished next quarter that turns out to solve the wrong problem.
* **Small team, high ownership.** Everyone builds and everyone supports. You will not be handed a narrow lane and left in it.
* **Honesty over polish.** Saying "I don't know, here is how I would find out" is a good answer here. Overstating what you have done is not.

 **Where this goes**

* The people who do well on this team end up understanding the business process better than whoever wrote the specification — and then they stop needing the specification.
* If you want to become techno\-functional rather than a career developer, say so in your application. We will put you in requirement sessions, give you process ownership as you earn it, and back you into that transition. We would rather grow you into it than watch you leave to do it somewhere else.

 **Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)**

  

* 10\+ years hands\-on with SAP, with real depth in at least one area — ABAP, Basis, FI/CO, MM, SD or comparable.
* 3\+ years on S/4HANA, including at least one full implementation.
* Strong grasp of SAP architecture, system landscape and integration technologies.
* Demonstrated configuration and customization work, not only specification writing.
* Experience with modern integration — OData, REST APIs, SAP cloud solutions.
* Able to sit with a business user and be understood. This is a customer\-facing development role.
* **Valued, not required**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology or a related field.
* Breadth across ERP, EWM, TM or analytics.
* AI experience outside of SAP world
* SAP certifications in ABAP, technical or integration areas.
* Cloud platform knowledge — AWS, Azure or GCP — and hybrid architectures.
* Agile and DevOps practice in SAP environments.
* Manufacturing, supply chain or finance process background.
* RPA experience and its integration with SAP.

 **More about us (Mandatory)**


ABB Installation Products Division (formerly Thomas Betts), helps manage the connection, protection and distribution of electrical power from source to socket. The Division’s products are engineered to provide ease of installation and perform in demanding and harsh conditions, helping to ensure safety and continuous operation for utilities, businesses and people around the world. The Commercial Essentials product segment includes electrical junction boxes, commercial fittings, strut and cable tray metal framing systems for commercial and residential construction. The Premier Industrial product segment includes multiple product lines, such as Ty\-Rap® cable ties, T\&B Liquid tight Systems® protection products, PVC coated and nylon conduit systems, power connection and grounding systems, and cable protection systems of conduits and fittings for harsh and industrial applications. The Division also manufactures solutions for medium\-voltage applications used in the utility market under its marquee brands including Elastimold reclosers and switchgear, capacitor switches, current limiting fuses, Homac distribution connectors, Hi\-Tech Valiant full\-range current limiting fuse for fire mitigation, faulted current indicators and distribution connectors, cable accessories and apparatus with products for overhead and underground distribution. Manufacturing includes made\-to\-stock and custom\-made solutions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

description:
### **Description**

  

**Role Summary:**  

  

The KYC \& Fraud Product Manager is responsible for driving the product, tooling and process improvement agenda across the CDD and Fraud functions at DAZN Bet. The role bridges operational requirements and technical delivery, ensuring that the systems, platforms and vendor solutions used by the CDD and Fraud teams are optimised, fit for purpose, and aligned with regulatory and commercial objectives.

The successful candidate will own the product roadmap for CDD and Fraud tooling, working with internal stakeholders and external vendors to scope, prioritise and deliver enhancements that improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and strengthen DAZN Bet's ability to identify and manage risk. The role also carries responsibility for MI reporting and analytics across both functions, ensuring that leadership has access to accurate, timely data to support decision\-making.

This is a newly created role, established as part of an Operational restructure to promote dedicated product management capacity within the Operations function. The role enables the CDD and Fraud departments to move from a reactive, operationally constrained posture to one focused on continuous improvement, automation and scalability.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Product Roadmap \& Strategy** — Own and maintain the product roadmap for CDD and Fraud tooling, identifying opportunities for enhancement, automation and integration. Prioritise initiatives based on operational impact, regulatory requirement and commercial value, ensuring alignment with the wider Operations and Technology strategy.


* **Vendor \& Platform Management** — Manage relationships with third\-party CDD, KYC, identity verification and fraud prevention vendors. Ensure service levels are met, contracts are appropriate, and that DAZN Bet derives maximum value from its vendor partnerships. Lead procurement and onboarding activity for new tooling as required.


* **Process Improvement \& Automation** — Work closely with the Head of CDD and Ops teams to identify operational bottlenecks, manual processes and inefficiencies. Scope and deliver solutions that reduce manual effort, improve accuracy and accelerate throughput — including automation of routine tasks, workflow improvements and system integrations.


* **MI Reporting \& Analytics** — Design, build and maintain MI reporting across CDD and Fraud, providing accurate and timely data on volumes, SLA performance, quality metrics, fraud losses, chargeback rates and risk trends. Ensure leadership has the information required to make informed decisions and demonstrate regulatory compliance.

Work with the Head of CDD, Head of AML and Compliance team to ensure that systems and processes reflect current legislation and licence conditions.


* **Fraud Tooling \& Strategy** — Own the product and tooling strategy for fraud prevention, including chargeback management and bonus abuse detection. Work with the Fraud team (Junior KYC \& Fraud Product Manager, and operational staff within AML and Risk \& Payments) to ensure tooling is configured and optimised to minimise losses.


* **Scalability \& Market Expansion** — Ensure CDD and Fraud tooling is configured and scalable to support new market entry. Contribute to market entry planning by identifying tooling requirements, vendor capabilities and integration needs ahead of launch.


* **Stakeholder Engagement** — Act as the primary point of contact between the CDD/Fraud operations and Technology teams, ensuring requirements are clearly articulated, prioritised and delivered. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver to deadlines

**Leadership Skills*** Experience of managing or mentoring junior staff
* Ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders and drive delivery without direct authority
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.

**Required Experience*** Previous experience in a product management, product ownership or business analysis role within CDD, KYC, AML or fraud operations.
* Experience of working with third\-party vendors in a regulated environment

* Experience of building and maintaining MI reporting.

title: Product Owner III
description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting\-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.
By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real\-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
### **Role Overview:**



PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help drive our mobile product roadmap from vision to delivery. This individual will take roadmap initiatives and solution briefs and break them down into clear, well\-structured PRDs that our engineering teams can pick up and execute against — keeping delivery moving in a fast\-paced, iterative environment.



This role sits within our broader Mobile Platform and Framework effort — the underlying solution that lets customers bring a highly customizable, flexible branded app to market — with expected primary focus on Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), a web\-based portal being built on top of the Mobile Platform that will let end customers modify, update, and change elements of their own mobile app themselves, backed by a full publishing engine. MEM is early in its build, so this is a chance to help shape a new product from the ground up alongside engineering and design. Exact scope of ownership across the Mobile Platform and MEM will be finalized as the team ramps up, and there is flexibility for this to evolve.



As a Product Owner, you are a critical member of an Agile development team, translating product strategy into high\-quality, high\-value features. You'll work closely with Agile engineering teams, Product Managers, customers, and business stakeholders to shape requirements for our consumer\-facing mobile experiences. Prior experience in Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analyst roles for a consumer\-focused mobile app or platform/framework product is highly desired.



This role is expected to use AI tools and processes as a core part of how work gets done — accelerating requirements\-gathering, documentation, and story breakdown so the team can move faster without sacrificing quality.


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* **Stay aligned with and contribute to** the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), with visibility into the broader Mobile Platform/Framework
* Translate roadmap initiatives and solution briefs into detailed, engineering\-ready PRDs and user stories
* Help define and evolve requirements for MEM's publishing engine — how customers configure, preview, and push changes to their live mobile app
* As needed, extend into Mobile Platform\-level decisions (what should be configurable, extensible, or standardized across customers) as they intersect with MEM
* Work closely with Support to understand and prioritize customer\-reported issues affecting the mobile app and platform experience
* Work closely with system users (customers, partners, consulting) to understand product needs and translate them into actionable user stories
* Apply technical astuteness, attention to detail, and proactivity to drive closure and optimize development team throughput
* Use AI\-assisted tools and workflows to speed up requirements analysis, documentation, and backlog preparation
* Serve as a product evangelist, particularly with Product Managers and Business teams, helping them understand platform best practices
* Develop documentation for new mobile and MEM features, including UI mockups, process flows, and data sequence diagrams
* Attend sprint planning meetings and work with the team to define sprint goals
* Guide Agile teams in breaking down user stories and defining acceptance criteria
* Ensure the product backlog is prioritized and properly balanced between new product work and maintenance
* Collaborate with engineering during sprints to review output and answer questions about desired functionality and outcomes
* Ensure the team has an appropriately groomed backlog ready for sprint planning; monitor ready stories vs. velocity
* Conduct backlog refinement meetings, sprint reviews, and product demos
* Manage the product backlog in ALM tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
* Author and publish product release notes and customer notifications
* Own release planning for Mobile Platform and MEM initiatives
### **Qualifications:**


* Prior experience with consumer\-facing mobile apps (iOS/Android) — writing requirements, PRDs, or user stories for a mobile product strongly preferred
* Experience with platform, framework, or configurable/multi\-tenant products is a strong plus, given the customizable nature of the Mobile Platform
* Comfort defining requirements for a 0\-to\-1 product (like MEM) with evolving scope, including working with design on portal/UI workflows
* Ability to break down ambiguous roadmap items and solution briefs into scoped, sequenced, engineering\-ready PRDs
* Familiarity with mobile\-specific considerations (app store release processes, platform guidelines, mobile UX patterns) is a plus
* Fluent with — or genuinely eager to learn — AI\-assisted product workflows (e.g., using AI tools to accelerate PRD drafting, backlog refinement, research synthesis, and documentation) in order to move quickly in a fast\-paced environment
* 2–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Manager, Product Owner, or similar role, including at least 2 years working as an Agile Product Owner
* Highly motivated self\-starter with a desire to help others, take action, and seek out resources to excel within the role
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into non\-technical terms and vice versa
* Ability to work independently as a contributing member of a high\-paced, focused team, managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to work under pressure
* Ability to socialize ideas and influence decisions without direct authority
* Collaborative by nature, with a strong desire to dig in and learn independently and through asking questions
* Comfortable partnering with and reporting to leadership based in the U.S., with strong cross\-time\-zone communication habits
* Working knowledge of product and sprint backlog tracking, burn\-down metrics, velocity, and work breakdown techniques
* Solid understanding of Agile software development processes and principles
* Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, or equivalent work experience
### **Preferred Skills:**


* Domain experience in Convenience Retail, ERP, Logistics, or Financial transaction processing solutions
### **Behavioral Competencies:**


* Ensures Accountability
* Manages Complexity
* Communicates Effectively
* Balances Stakeholders
* Collaborates Effectively
PDI is committed to offering a well\-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market\-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work\-life balance with ample time off \[time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

This position designs, develops, and manages activities for a specific product or group of products from product definition and planning through production, release, and end of life. Responsible for the full product lifecycle management, with a technical focus, including strategy, design, development, management, and end of life of new, existing or acquisition products. Leverage market insights to understand market/customer needs as well as emerging technology developments and trends to identify new opportunities or make adjustments to current product offerings. * Proficient understanding of the basics of the role of technical product management, agile practices/methodologies and the Software Development Life Cycle ((SDLC)

* Proficient TPM assigned complex feature work on a single, primary product

title: Senior Manager - RGM
description:
Overview:  

ICC is a growing function within PepsiCo that leverages one strategy and common approach to introduce new, technology\-driven capabilities and elevate service quality while meeting current and future business needs. PEP RGM is a key priority function where transformation, technology, strategy and capabilities enablement are aimed to be the best in class, and to be standardized and deployed globally. The vision is to develop playbook to develop analytic packs with insights across Brand Ladders, Channel PPA, In\-Market Pack Price realization, Trade Investment Strategy, Promo ROI and Mix Management. This work will accelerate growth through efficient positioning across price tiers, optimized channel\-based package types, right pricing, well directed commercial strategy and increase promotional ROI driven by enhanced and standardized insights.




This position will be part of the ICC \- Revenue growth Management organization. This position contributes to the success of the company and contribute to growth through strategy development, and implementation of RGM frameworks. The incumbement will work for different markets across the globe and work with different stakeholders to develop RGM playbooks and ensure analytics execution

  


Responsibilities:  

Functional Responsibilities

* ICC RGM analyst will be responsible for conducting data analyses across all RGM levers \- Pricing, Promotion, Assortment Mix and Trade Investment
* Lead data aggregation and harmonization that will form the backbone of RGM analytics
* Collaborate with Market Cluster Leads to understand market dynamics and incorporate market feedback into analyses
* Bring out Next Gen Revenue Management insights by implementing advance analytics
* Integrate insights comprehensive summaries for RGM Tower Lead and RGM leader
* Improve understanding of pricing, promotions, pack architecture and trade investments through use of data analytic tools and visualization tools
* Improve processes of analyses and data management across category business units and marketing functions
* Develop observations/insights for each analysis in the RGM playbook and synthesize insights across analyses to create a storyline of opportunities
* Implement continued improvements and simplifications of processes, standardization of reporting and optimal use of technology
* Create an inclusive and collaborative environment
* Adavanced Analytics – Price Elasticity, Promotion Effectiveness and knowledge of Python, R, Tableau/Power Bi


Key Activities


* Perform granular level analysis to identify growth opportunities
* Prepare data for the analyses to be performed (Data Pre\-processing Tools – Alteryx/KNIME exp preferred)
* Understand the nuances of the product category and market to tailor the output according to business needs
* Run the analyses and create visualizations (Power BI and Tableau experience preferred); prepare drill down analyses to derive insights
* Create a storyline out of various analyses output for the business to comprehend the output
* Meet the service level agreements and perform QC of the end\-to\-end analysis
* Expand playbook analytic pack scope to include additional analyses upon alignment with market

  


Qualifications:  

* \+7 years of experience in Retail Analytics/Category Management/Revenue Management
* 2\-3 years of relevant professional experience working with large data sets and experience in CPG /Consulting / ICC Organizations
* Experience in any of the RGM lever practices\- Pricing, Promo, Assortment, Trade Investment
* Strong analytics skills with expertise in data analytics and data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI
* Strong Advanced Analytics acumen, Agile ways of working, managing high end data science
* Prior experience in data analytics to derive data driven insights and consolidate them to generate recommendations
* Experience in developing data\-driven models for sales and marketing function
* Ability to handle multiple work streams simultaneously and to tight deadlines in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
* Experience working with stakeholders in North America, LATAM, APAC, or EMEA markets (preferred)
* Very strong analytical skills – excellent competency in MS Excel is a must, as is experience of managing complex, incomplete \& inconsistent datasets and defining strategic analytics (market sizing/growth forecasts etc).
* Experience in Tableau / Power Bi is preferred
* Proven experience using PowerPoint and ability to producing visually compelling presentations (i.e. beyond just operating the software) that are impactful with a senior audience
* Clarity in communication (English language) to enable production of a very high standard of commentary that is impactful and credible amongst our most senior audiences.
* Bachelor’s in commerce/business administration/Engg., Master’s degree is a plus
* Best\-in\-class time management skills, ability to multitask, set priorities and plan

title: Global Campaign Manager
description:
Overview:
**About JAGGAER**  

JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source\-to\-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.  

Our 1,200\+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products \- ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.  

For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com **Role Summary:**  

The Global Nurture Campaigns Manager will own the execution, optimization, and governance of JAGGAER's marketing automation programs across Salesforce and Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement). This role will be responsible for building scalable campaign infrastructure, managing automated journeys, maintaining data quality, and ensuring marketing programs move prospects and customers through the funnel effectively.  

This role will partner closely with Demand Generation, Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, Content, Digital, and regional marketing teams to translate campaign strategy into technically sound, measurable programs. The position will manage campaign setup, segmentation, lead routing, scoring, nurture programs, email execution, testing, reporting, and ongoing platform optimization.  

The ideal candidate combines strong hands\-on Pardot and Salesforce expertise with campaign operations discipline, lifecycle marketing knowledge, analytical thinking, and the ability to improve processes at scale.
Principal Responsibilities:
**Marketing Automation Platform Ownership:*** Serve as a primary owner and power user of Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement), ensuring the platform is configured, maintained, and used according to established marketing operations standards.
* Manage automation rules, engagement programs, dynamic lists, completion actions, scoring, grading, segmentation logic, suppression rules, and other core Pardot functionality.
* Maintain strong alignment between Pardot and Salesforce, including field mappings, campaign synchronization, lead and contact records, campaign membership, and activity visibility.
* Monitor platform health, sync errors, automation conflicts, data issues, and operational risks, resolving issues directly or coordinating with Sales Operations, IT, and external partners.

 **Campaign Management \& Execution*** Own the technical setup and execution of integrated marketing campaigns across email, webinars, events, paid media, content programs, and other demand generation channels.
* Build and manage Salesforce Campaigns and Pardot campaign assets, including emails, forms, landing pages, lists, automation rules, tracking links, and campaign member statuses.

title: Senior Technical Product Owner
description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.**


We are looking for a **Senior Technical Product Owner** to drive the vision, roadmap, and delivery of key digital products, including FinOps and AI agent solutions. This role will own products end\-to\-end, ensuring they deliver measurable business value, drive adoption, and support WSA's digital transformation journey.

**What you will Own**
---------------------

* **FinOps.** Our FinOps products give engineering teams and finance a shared, trustworthy view of cloud spend across our providers and push cost accountability into the teams that create the cost. You own their vision, roadmap and backlog end to end.
* **Discovery for what comes next.** New products are taking shape in our cloud and platform strategy area. You will help develop them through product discovery, prototypes and stakeholder interviews, and give them a definition and a first roadmap. Who owns them in the end is decided later.
* **Possibly more.** Depending on the profile we find, smaller existing products can be added to your responsibilities – our Backstage developer portal, or our Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud offerings, for example.
* **Outcomes, not output.** You are measured on adoption across the applications on the platform and on the decisions that change because of your product, not on the number of stories closed. You present your roadmap and your results to leadership yourself.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Talk to the people who use our FinOps products – platform teams, application teams and finance – and turn what you learn into a roadmap they recognise as theirs.
* Write the user stories and acceptance criteria yourself. You know the difference between a story and a specification.
* Prioritise against business value, technical feasibility and the platform strategy, and defend the ranking when it is challenged.
* Work with the engineering team day to day: refinement, design reviews, demos and releases. You can read the code and the architecture, and you will.
* Track adoption and outcomes, and act on what the numbers tell you.
* Manage expectations and dependencies with stakeholders across WSA.
* Run product discovery and stakeholder interviews for new products in the strategy area

**What you bring**
------------------

* A technical background: 5\+ years in software engineering, architecture or platform engineering, and real responsibility for deciding what gets built – as a product owner, a tech lead or an architect.
* You have shipped something other teams depend on – an internal platform, a service, a tool – and lived with the consequences.
* You understand cloud platforms well enough to challenge an engineer's estimate and to spot when a cost report is wrong. Hands\-on FinOps experience is a plus; the practice can be learned, the instinct cannot.
* You have made a case to senior stakeholders, won some and lost some, and can explain what you would do differently.
* You can work with an empowered agile team without needing to run it. Scrum or SAFe familiarity is useful; process for its own sake is not.
* You are interested in LLM\- and agent\-based solutions and have a realistic view of what they can and cannot do today.
* Clear written and spoken English, and comfortable working in a multi\-region team across time zones..

**Who we are**
--------------


At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.


Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.


With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

**Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.**


WSA is an equal\-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

Axiado is building the future of AI powered digital infrastructure. We are a fast\-growing, well funded silicon, systems, and solutions company pioneering a new category of semiconductor called the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU) that combines advanced hardware security, AI driven resilience and efficiency, and real\-time platform management. Our technology protects the world’s most critical infrastructure—from data centers to next generation cloud and AI platforms—by securing systems at the foundation levels of hardware, independent of host CPUs and operating systems.


Founded in 2019 and now over 150 employees are strong, Axiado has evolved into a recognized leader in the convergence of AI, security, and silicon innovation. We partner with and are actively engaged in commercial programs with multiple Tier 1 industry leaders, validating both our technology and our long\-term market trajectory. Axiado has also won numerous industry awards for our ground\-breaking products and technological innovations, including being named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Security, winning the 2025 Global InfoSec Award for Outstanding AI Security Solution, and being named a finalist for the Global Semiconductor Alliance’s 2025 “Start\-Up to Watch” award.


At Axiado, developing breakthrough technology takes more than great engineering—it takes a team of exceptional people who collaborate boldly, challenge assumptions, and take pride in building what comes next. We value curiosity, execution, respect, and a shared desire to make a meaningful impact on the security and reliability of the digital world.


If you’re driven to innovate, energized by hard problems, and excited to help define the future of secure AI infrastructure, we invite you to apply and join us on this journey.

 **Job Description**  

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our System Manager team.


In this role, you will have an opportunity to work alongside a high\-performing engineering team on cutting\-edge technologies that enable secure root of trust functionality. You will contribute to the design, development, integration, and validation of low\-level platform firmware responsible for system management, secure boot, platform security, device management, and recovery functionality.

 **Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 6–10 years of experience in Embedded Firmware/Software development.
* **Strong proficiency in Embedded C, data structures, and low\-level programming**.
* **Strong hands\-on experience with any RTOS, with FreeRTOS experience preferred.**
* Good understanding of ARM\-based SoCs, multicore architecture.
* Experience developing/debugging low\-level drivers.
* **Strong system\-level debugging skills** using JTAG, logs, crash/exception analysis.
* **Familiar with Git**, code reviews, unit testing, static analysis, and CI/CD.
* Ability to independently own features from requirements and design through implementation, integration, validation, and release.
* **Strong communication skills** with the ability to collaborate with all other stake holders

  

**Additional Information**  

* Experience with SPDM, PLDM, MCTP protocols
* Experience with Caliptra, Crypto/security APIs
* Experience with bootloaders and platform firmware, including initialization, boot flows, reset handling, recovery, and firmware\-update mechanisms.
* Understanding of firmware authentication/signature verification, OTP provisioning
